name: Adam Albright
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonology, morphology, and language acquisition through computational models and paradigms.
summary_zh: 研究音系学、形态学和语言获得，通过计算模型和 paradigms 方法。

name: Amir Anvari
title: Assistant Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies semantics and pragmatics through theoretical and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究语义学和语用学，采用理论和实验方法。

name: Michel DeGraff
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies language, linguistics, and education for decolonization and liberation through digital platforms and legal battles.
summary_zh: 研究语言学、语言和教育以实现去殖民化和解放，通过数字平台和法律斗争。

name: Kai von Fintel
title: Andrew W. Mellon Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies meaning, semantics, and pragmatics through philosophical analysis.
summary_zh: 研究意义、语义学和语用学通过哲学分析。

name: Edward Flemming
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonology and phonetics, focusing on dispersion theory, coarticulation, and speech perception.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和语音学，专注于扩散理论、共同化和语音感知。

name: Suzanne Flynn
title: Faculty
summary: Studies second language acquisition through experimental and theoretical approaches, focusing on innate vs. learned aspects and grammatical mapping.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得的先天与学习之争以及语法映射，采用实验和理论方法。

name: Danny Fox
title: Linguistics Section Head, Anshen-Chomsky Professor of Language & Thought
summary: Studies syntax and semantics, particularly scalar implicatures and presupposition projection, through theoretical linguistics and natural language semantics.
summary_zh: 研究句法和语义学，尤其是标量含意和预设投射，通过理论语言学和自然语言语义学的方法。

name: Martin Hackl
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies semantics, syntax, and psycholinguistics through theoretical and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究语义学、句法学和心理语言学，采用理论和实验方法。

name: Sabine Iatridou
title: Faculty
summary: Studies modal and imperative semantics through theoretical and empirical approaches.
summary_zh: 研究模态和命令语义学，通过理论和实证方法。

name: Michael Kenstowicz
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonology and phonetics, focusing on tone sandhi, vowel harmony, and Mandarin tones through fieldwork and acoustic analysis.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和音位学，专注于声调变化、元音和谐以及普通话声调通过实地考察和声学分析。

name: Shota Mom
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of Japanese through experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究日语的音系学和音法学，采用实验方法。

name: Elise Newman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies syntax, semantics/pragmatics, and first language acquisition through various projects and publications.
summary_zh: 研究句法学、语义学/语用学和第一语言习得，通过多个项目和出版物进行。

name: David Pesetsky
title: Ferrari P. Ward Professor of Modern Languages and Linguistics, and Margaret MacVicar Faculty Fellow
summary: Studies syntax, the laws governing sentence composition in languages, and its interaction with semantics.
summary_zh: 研究句法学，即世界语言中句子构成的规律及其与语义学的交互作用。

name: Norvin Richards
title: Dean’s Distinguished Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies syntax, particularly wh-movement and contiguity theory, with a focus on Tagalog and endangered languages.
summary_zh: 研究句法，尤其是 wh-移动和接触理论，重点关注塔加洛语和濒危语言。

name: Viola Schmitt
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies semantics through linguistic analysis and theoretical frameworks.
summary_zh: 研究语义学通过语言分析和理论框架。

name: Evelina Fedorenko
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies language processing in the brain using behavioral, brain imaging, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中的语言处理，使用行为学、脑成像和计算方法。

name: Edward A Gibson
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the syntax of human languages and how people process and learn language using behavioral experiments and statistical modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人类语言的句法学以及人们如何学习和处理语言，使用行为实验和统计建模方法。

name: Nancy Kanwisher
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Walter A Rosenblith Professor
summary: Studies the functional organization of the brain, focusing on regions involved in visual perception, language, social perception, and intuitive physics.
summary_zh: 研究大脑的功能组织，重点关注涉及视觉感知、语言、社会感知和直观物理的区域。

name: Roger Levy
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive processes of language processing and acquisition through computational modeling and psycholinguistic experiments.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理和习得的认知过程，通过计算建模和心理语言学实验。

name: Robert Mark Richardson
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain electrophysiology and behavior in patients undergoing functional neurosurgery, focusing on basal ganglia-cortical dynamics and closed-loop brain stimulation for epilepsy.
summary_zh: 研究功能性神经外科手术患者的脑电生理和行为，重点是基底节-皮层动力学和癫痫的闭环脑刺激。

name: Jonathan David Bobaljik
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies morphology, syntax, and endangered languages through comparative analysis of Germanic, Slavic, and Arctic languages.
summary_zh: 研究形态学、句法学和濒危语言，通过比较分析日耳曼语、斯拉夫语和北极语系的语言。

name: Tanya Bondarenko
title: Assistant Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies syntax and semantics through fieldwork in Altaic and Muskogean languages.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和句法学，通过田野调查研究阿尔泰语系和穆斯科根语系的语言。

name: Gennaro Chierchia
title: Haas Foundations Professor of Linguistics
areas: the interface of semantics with language development
summary: Studies semantics, syntax/semantics mapping, pragmatics, and the philosophy of language through the interface with language development and language pathology.
summary_zh: 研究语义学、句法/语义映射、语用学以及语言哲学，特别是它们与语言发展和语言病理学的接口。

name: Kathryn Davidson
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies semantics, pragmatics, language acquisition, sign languages, experimental methods, and language and cognition.
summary_zh: 研究语义学、语用学、语言习得、手语、实验方法以及语言与认知。

name: Kathryn Franich
title: Assistant Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonetics, phonology, prosody, and tone through experimental methods and fieldwork in African languages.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学、音法学、语调和实验方法及田野调查。

name: Jeremy Rau
title: Diebold Professor of Indo-European Linguistics and Philology
summary: Studies historical linguistics of Greek, Latin, and Indo-European languages through analysis of Homeric texts and Indo-Iranian linguistics.
summary_zh: 研究希腊语、拉丁语和印欧语的历史语言学，通过分析荷马文本和印欧伊朗语言学。

name: Kevin Ryan
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonology, prosody, and metrics using quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究音系学、语调和韵律，并使用定量方法。

name: Athulya Aravind
title: Associate Professor on Term
summary: Studies language acquisition in children and adult linguistic representations through behavioral experiments and theoretical linguistics.
summary_zh: 研究儿童语言习得和成人语言表示，通过行为实验和理论语言学方法。

name: Claire Bowern
title: Professor & Coordinator (NAIS Certificate)
summary: Studies language change in Indigenous Australia through archival and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究澳大利亚原住民语言的变化，使用档案和计算方法。

name: Simon Charlow
title: Associate Professor & DGS
summary: Studies the relationship between linguistic form and meaning through formal and computational methods, focusing on quantification, scope, and indefiniteness.
summary_zh: 研究语言形式与意义之间的关系，通过形式化和计算方法，重点关注量词、范围和不定指代。

name: Veneeta Dayal
title: Dorothy R. Diebold Professor of Linguistics & Chair
summary: Studies cross-linguistic semantics through theoretical and empirical approaches.
summary_zh: 研究跨语言语义学，采用理论和实证方法。

name: Robert Frank
title: Professor & DUS (Computing and Linguistics)
summary: Studies computational models of language learning and processing using Tree Adjoining Grammar formalism.
summary_zh: 研究语言学习和处理的计算模型以及树接合文法形式主义的作用。

name: Tom McCoy
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how language is learned and represented in humans and artificial neural networks through computational modeling and human experiments.
summary_zh: 研究语言如何在人类和人工神经网络中学习和表示，通过计算建模和人类实验。

name: Maria Piñango
title: Professor
summary: Studies the integration of semantic and syntactic information during language comprehension using fMRI, focusing on syntax-lexico-semantic connections.
summary_zh: 研究语言理解过程中语义和句法信息的整合，使用fMRI技术，关注词汇语义与句法的联系。

name: Jason Shaw
title: Associate Professor & DUS (Linguistics)
summary: Studies phonological variation in speech through experimental methods like eye-tracking and Electromagnetic Articulography.
summary_zh: 研究语音形式如何结构自然语音变异，并通过眼动追踪和电磁articulography等实验方法探索听者的解释。

name: Natalie Weber
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the syntax-prosody interface and phonological realization in Blackfoot and Loma.
summary_zh: 研究句法学与音系学接口以及黑福特语和洛马语中的音系实现。

name: Jim Wood
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies syntactic theory and its interactions with semantics and morphology, focusing on Icelandic and dialect variation in English.
summary_zh: 研究句法学与其与语义学和形态学的相互作用，重点关注冰岛语和英语方言变异。

name: Raffaella Zanuttini
title: Professor
summary: Studies syntactic variation and negation across English, Italian, and Korean to understand grammatical limits.
summary_zh: 研究英语、意大利语和韩语中的句法变异和否定，以理解语法的极限。

name: Arto Tapani Anttila
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonology, morphology, syntax, and metrics through various methods including probabilistic models and deep learning.
summary_zh: 研究音系学、形态学、句法学和韵律学，采用概率模型和深度学习等多种方法。

name: Meg Cychosz
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children learn complex speech patterns and language development across different cultures and hearing environments using eye-tracking, speech recognition, and fNIRS.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习复杂的语音模式和语言发展，以及不同文化和听力环境中的跨文化差异，使用眼动追踪、语音识别和fNIRS技术。

name: Vera Gribanova
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonetics and phonology through linguistic fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和句法学通过语言田野调查。

name: Boris Harizanov
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies syntax, morphology, and prosody, and their interactions.
summary_zh: 研究句法学、形态学和音律学及其相互作用。

name: Robert Hawkins
title: Assistant Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies cognitive mechanisms of communication through interactive experiments and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究交流的认知机制通过互动实验和计算模型。

name: Dan Jurafsky
title: Jackson Eli Reynolds Professor in Humanities, and Professor of Linguistics and Computer Science
summary: Studies natural language processing and machine learning, focusing on language models and speech recognition.
summary_zh: 研究自然语言处理和机器学习，专注于语言模型和语音识别。

name: Beth Levin
title: William H. Bonsall Professor in the Humanities
summary: Studies lexical semantics, syntax, morphology, and language typology through various research areas.
summary_zh: 研究词汇语义学、句法学、形态学和语言类型学。

name: Robert Jay Podesva
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies the social significance of phonetic variation in identity construction through interactional sociophonetics.
summary_zh: 研究语音变异的社会意义及其在身份建构中的作用，通过互动社会音韵学方法。

name: Christopher G. Potts
title: Professor of Linguistics and, by courtesy, of Computer Science
summary: Studies language processing and semantics through computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理和语义学通过计算方法。

name: Cory Shain
title: Assistant Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies human language comprehension through interdisciplinary research combining linguistics, neuroscience, and artificial intelligence.
summary_zh: 研究人类语言理解通过结合语言学、神经科学和人工智能的跨学科研究。

name: Nandi Sims
title: Assistant Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies language variation and change in situations of language contact, focusing on social identities and hegemonic structures of race.
summary_zh: 研究语言接触情境中的语言变异和变化，关注社会身份和种族霸权结构。

name: Meghan Sumner
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies how listeners perceive and understand spoken language variation through social patterns.
summary_zh: 研究听者如何感知和理解语音变异的社会模式。

name: Cleo Condoravdi
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies semantics and pragmatics through computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究语义学和语用学通过计算语言学方法。

name: Gašper Beguš
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies how intelligence unfolds through language using interpretable AI, artificial babies, and cross-species linguistics.
summary_zh: 研究语言中智能的展开，使用可解释的人工智能、人工婴儿和跨物种语言学。

name: Isaac L. Bleaman
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies language variation and change in minority communities, focusing on Yiddish, using digital corpora and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究少数民族语言的变化，特别是在雅利安语中的应用，使用数字语料库和计算方法。

name: Amy Rose Deal
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies syntax and semantics through fieldwork on Nez Perce.
summary_zh: 研究自然语言的语义学和句法学，通过田野工作研究Nez Perce语言。

name: Susanne Gahl
title: Professor of Linguistics and Cognitive Science
summary: Studies language production and comprehension, focusing on pronunciation, aphasia symptoms, and spelling errors to understand central linguistic processes.
summary_zh: 研究语言生产和理解，关注发音、失语症症状和拼写错误，以理解核心语言学过程。

name: Andrew Garrett
title: Professor of Linguistics, Nadine M. Tang and Bruce L. Smith Professor of Cross-Cultural Social Sciences
summary: Studies language typology and historical linguistics through comparative analysis of diverse language families.
summary_zh: 研究语言类型学和社会语言学，通过对比分析多种语言家族的语言现象。

name: Nicole Holliday
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies how linguistic variation reflects and constructs social identities, focusing on intonation and voice quality, with applications in speech technology and political speech.
summary_zh: 研究语言变异如何反映和构建社会身份，重点关注语调和音质，并应用于语音技术和政治演讲。

name: Sharon Inkelas
title: Distinguished Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonology and morphology and their interface in child phonology.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和形态学及其界面，特别是在儿童音系学中的应用。

name: Peter Jenks
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies syntactic structures and their interfaces with semantics and phonology across various languages.
summary_zh: 研究句法结构及其与语义和音系的接口，涵盖多种语言。

name: Darya Kavitskaya
title: Professor of Slavic Languages and Literatures and of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonological theory and phonetics of Slavic, Turkic, and Uralic languages through acoustic and articulatory analysis.
summary_zh: 研究音系理论和音系学中的斯拉夫语、突厥语和乌拉尔语系语言，通过声学和发音分析进行研究。

name: Lev Michael
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies the interplay of language structure and social activity in Amazonian languages through fieldwork and historical linguistics.
summary_zh: 研究语言结构和社会活动之间的相互作用，通过田野调查和历史语言学方法探讨亚马逊语族的语言特征。

name: Line Mikkelsen
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies syntax and language maintenance/revitalization in California, Denmark, and Greenland.
summary_zh: 研究句法学和语言保护/复兴，涉及加利福尼亚、丹麦和格陵兰的语言社区。

name: Terry Regier
title: Professor of Linguistics and Cognitive Science
summary: Studies the relation of language and cognition through computational principles, cross-language semantic data, and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究语言与认知的关系，通过计算原则、跨语言语义数据和行为实验。

name: Hannah Sande
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonological processes and interfaces with syntax and morphology in Kru languages through documentary linguistic work.
summary_zh: 研究克鲁语族的音系过程及其与句法和形态的接口，通过文献语言学工作进行探索。

name: Jack Duff
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Austronesian languages through comparative analysis.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语系的音系学和句法学，通过比较分析进行研究。

name: Jonah Katz
title: Faculty
summary: Studies tone and intonation in Bantu languages through fieldwork and acoustic analysis.
summary_zh: 研究班图语系的声调和语调通过实地考察和声学分析。

name: Michelle Yuan
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in East Asian languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究东亚语言的音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行。

name: Ben Eischens
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Austronesian languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语系的语言音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行研究。

name: Laurel Perkins
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Austronesian languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语系的语言音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行研究。

name: Stefan Keine
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Austronesian languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语系的语言音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行研究。

name: Claire Moore-Cantwell
title: Faculty
summary: Studies tone and intonation in Bantu languages through fieldwork and acoustic analysis.
summary_zh: 研究班图语系的音系和语调，通过实地考察和声学分析进行。

name: Ethan Poole
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Austronesian languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语系的语言音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行研究。

name: Dylan Bumford
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Austronesian languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语系的语言音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行。

name: Tim Hunter
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Austronesian languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语系的语言音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行。

name: Kie Ross Zuraw
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of tone and intonation through fieldwork and acoustic analysis.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和音位学中的声调和语调，通过田野调查和声学分析进行。

name: Harold Torrence
title: I am a professor in the UCLA Department of Linguistics. My research focuses on the comparative syntax and morphology of African and Native American languages.
summary: Studies the syntax and morphology of African and Native American languages through comparative analysis.
summary_zh: 研究非洲和北美语言的句法学和形态学。

name: Megha Sundara
title: Faculty
summary: Studies linguistic phenomena through various methods.
summary_zh: 通过多种方法研究语言学现象。

name: Yael Sharvit
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Semitic languages through descriptive and comparative methods.
summary_zh: 研究闪语系的语言的音系学和句法学，通过描述性和比较性方法。

name: Jessica Rett
title: Faculty
summary: Studies formal semantics, pragmatics, and philosophy of language using logic to model linguistic meaning.
summary_zh: 研究形式语义学、语用学和语言哲学，使用逻辑来建模语言意义。

name: Anoop Mahajan
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Indian languages through descriptive and comparative methods.
summary_zh: 研究印度语言的音系学和句法学，采用描述性和比较性方法。

name: Sun-Ah Jun
title: Faculty
summary: Studies Korean phonology and intonation through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究韩语音系学和语调通过田野调查和语料库分析。

name: Jesse Harris
title: Faculty
summary: Studies language development through projects in the UCLA Language Processing Lab.
summary_zh: 研究语言使用者的语言发展，通过UCLA语言处理实验室的项目进行。

name: David Goldstein
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Austronesian languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语系的音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行。

name: Farrell Ackerman
title: Professor and Director of the
summary: Studies language acquisition and development through cognitive and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言获得和发展，通过认知和行为方法。

name: Eric Baković
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonological patterns and computational devices in different languages through theoretical and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究不同语言中的音系模式和计算工具。

name: Gabriela Caballero
title: Professor and Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies morphology and phonology in Uto-Aztecan languages through documentation and psycholinguistic investigation.
summary_zh: 研究美洲原住民语言（尤其是乌托-阿兹特克语）的形态学和音系学，并通过语言文档化和心理语言学研究来探讨形态音位变体模式。

name: Ivano Caponigro
title: Professor
summary: Studies cross-linguistic formal semantics and its interfaces with formal pragmatics and syntax through wh-constructions and relative clauses in various languages.
summary_zh: 研究不同语言如何通过句子中的不同组合表达相同意义，特别是通过主语从句和定语从句在印欧语系、中美洲语系、ASL 和阿迪吉语中的应用，涉及形式语义学、形式语用学和句法的接口。

name: Emily Clem
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies syntax and its interfaces with semantics and morphology through analysis of understudied languages, particularly Amazonian languages.
summary_zh: 研究句法学及其与语义学和形态学的接口，通过分析未研究过的语言，尤其是亚马逊地区的语言。

name: Rachel Dudley
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies language acquisition, focusing on semantic and pragmatic development through behavioral experiments and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究语言习得，特别是语义和语用能力的发展，通过行为实验和语料库分析进行探究。

name: Marc Garellek
title: Professor and Faculty Undergraduate Advisor (General and Speech Language Pathology)
summary: Studies the phonetics of laryngeal sounds across various languages using instrumental tools and acoustic analysis.
summary_zh: 研究世界上不同语言中的喉音声学特性，使用仪器工具和声学分析方法。

name: Grant Goodall
title: Professor and Director
summary: Studies the nature of syntactic representations and dependencies, their interaction with cognitive processes, and their acquisition over the lifespan through experimental techniques.
summary_zh: 研究句法表示和依赖的本质，它们与其他认知过程的交互作用以及它们在整个生命周期中的获得，通过实验技术进行研究。

name: Andrew Kehler
title: Professor
summary: Studies computational linguistics and psycholinguistics through discourse interpretation.
summary_zh: 研究计算语言学和心理语言学，通过话语解释。

name: Rachel Mayberry
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Austronesian languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究澳大利亚尼语言的音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行。

name: Sharon Rose
title: Professor and
summary: Studies phonological phenomena, including consonant and vowel harmony, in African languages through fieldwork and theoretical analysis.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言中的音系现象，如元音和辅音和谐，通过实地工作和理论分析。

name: Alex Warstadt
title: Assistant Professor in Linguistics and the Halıcıoğlu Data Science Institute (joint appointment)
summary: Studies language acquisition and processing using large language models and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 使用大型语言模型和实验方法研究语言获取和处理。

name: Anne Beatty-Martínez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how language use impacts cognition and supports adaptive change across the lifespan through diverse language experiences.
summary_zh: 研究语言使用如何影响认知并支持整个生命周期中的适应性变化，通过多样化的语言经验。

name: Benjamin Bergen
title: Professor
summary: Studies language comprehension and production, including grammar, word meaning, metaphor, and profanity.
summary_zh: 研究语言理解和生成，包括语法、词义、隐喻和粗俗语言。

name: Lera Boroditsky
title: Professor
summary: Studies how languages shape thought through cognitive and linguistic methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言如何塑造思维，采用认知和语言学方法。

name: Seana Coulson
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive electrophysiology, cognitive semantics, and experimental pragmatics through gesture comprehension and synesthesia research.
summary_zh: 研究认知电生理学、认知语义学和实验语用学，通过手势理解和联觉研究。

name: Federico Rossano
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies social cognition development, multimodal communication, and language evolution through comparative psychology and conversation analysis.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知的发展、多模态沟通以及语言进化，通过比较心理学和会话分析的方法。

name: Martin Zettersten
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies language and cognitive development through eye-tracking methods and big data analysis.
summary_zh: 研究语言和认知发展，通过眼动追踪方法和大数据分析。

name: Pranav Anand
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies semantics, pragmatics, syntax, and computational linguistics.
summary_zh: 研究语义学、语用学、句法学和计算语言学。

name: Ryan Thomas Bennett
title: Professor
summary: Studies linguistics through academic research and teaching.
summary_zh: 研究语言学，通过学术研究和教学。

name: Adrian Brasoveanu
title: Professor
summary: Studies computational (psycho)linguistics through academic building research and syllabus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究计算（心理）语言学，通过学术建筑中的研究和 syllabus 分析。

name: Dustin Chacón
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies linguistics through the Faculty Regular Faculty at the University of California at Santa Cruz.
summary_zh: 研究语言学，担任加州大学圣克鲁兹分校的常任教员。

name: Mia Gong
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies language acquisition through experimental methods.
summary_zh: 通过实验方法研究语言习得。

name: Jess H.-K. Law
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Austronesian languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语系的音系学和句法学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

name: Grant L McGuire
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies phonetics and perceptual learning through experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究语音学和感知学习，采用实验方法。

name: Jaye Padgett
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonology and phonetics, combining formal analysis with experimental methodologies, focusing on Slavic and Irish languages.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和语音学，结合形式分析和实验方法，主要关注斯拉夫语和盖尔语。

name: Roumyana Ivanova Pancheva
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Slavic languages through theoretical and descriptive approaches.
summary_zh: 研究斯拉夫语言的音系学和句法学，采用理论和描述的方法。

name: Amanda J Rysling
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies phonology through regular academic activities.
summary_zh: 研究音系学并通过常规学术活动进行。

name: Ivy Sichel
title: Professor
summary: Studies syntax, semantics, pronouns, quantifiers, and language and social identity in Semitic languages.
summary_zh: 研究句法学和语义学，代词和量词以及语言和社会身份在闪族语言中的表现。

name: Maziar D Toosarvandani
title: Professor
summary: Studies syntax, semantics, and pragmatics in Northern Paiute, Zapotec, and Persian languages.
summary_zh: 研究诺姆派尤特语、札波特克语和波斯语的句法学、语义学和语用学。

name: Matthew Webb Wagers
title: Professor
summary: Studies language comprehension and memory through psycholinguistics.
summary_zh: 研究语言理解和记忆的心理语言学。

name: Rachel Walker
title: Professor & Department Chair
summary: Studies phonology, phonetics, and morphology in Romance, Amazonian, Bantu, and Altaic languages.
summary_zh: 研究音系学、音位学和形态学在罗曼语、亚马逊语、班图语和阿尔泰语中的表现。

name: Argyro Katsika
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the interaction between prosodic structure and speech production through experimental methods across languages.
summary_zh: 研究韵律结构与发音之间的互动，通过跨语言的实验方法。

name: Eric W. Campbell
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies phonology, morphology, syntax, and historical linguistics of Otomanguean languages through fieldwork and typological perspectives.
summary_zh: 研究奥托芒戈伊安语言的音系学、形态学、句法学和历史语言学，通过田野调查和类型学视角。

name: Jaime Pérez González
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies morphology, syntax, and semantics in Mayan languages through descriptive grammar and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究玛雅语言的形态学、句法学和语义学，通过描写语法和田野调查进行研究。

name: Jessica K. Ivani
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies linguistic typology and crosslinguistic patterns in event packaging, grammatical categories, and Tibeto-Burman languages.
summary_zh: 研究语言类型学和事件打包、语法范畴以及藏缅语系语言的跨语言模式。

name: Lal Zimman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies trans language, gender, and voice in transgender communities through discourse analysis and sociophonetics.
summary_zh: 研究跨性别语言、性别和声音在跨性别社群中的社会音系学和话语分析。

name: Laurel Brehm
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies sentence production and comprehension, focusing on cognitive mechanisms like memory and attention using eye-tracking and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究句子生成和理解，关注记忆和注意力等认知机制，使用眼动追踪和计算建模方法。

name: Lina Hou
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies signed languages, child language acquisition, and linguistic ethnography through usage-based and ethnographic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究手语、儿童手语习得和语言民族志，采用使用基础和民族志方法。

name: Marianne Mithun
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies morphology, syntax, discourse, prosody, and their interrelations in various indigenous American and Austronesian languages through documentation and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究美洲原住民语言和澳大利亚语言的形态、句法、话语、语调及其相互关系，通过语言记录和实地工作进行探索。

name: Mary Bucholtz
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the use of language in the production of social identity among youth and the role of language in power dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究语言在青年社会身份构建中的作用及其在权力动态中的角色。

name: Matthew Gordon
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonetics, phonology, and prosody across various underdocumented languages like Estonian and Chickasaw.
summary_zh: 研究语音学、音系学和语调学，涵盖多种未充分记录的语言，如爱沙尼亚语和奇卡萨语。

name: Santiago Barreda
title: Professor & Chair
summary: Studies speech perception through behavioral experiments and statistical models, focusing on gender perception in children's voices.
summary_zh: 研究语音感知，通过行为实验和统计模型探讨儿童声音中的性别感知。

name: Raúl Aranovich
title: Professor
summary: Studies the interfaces between syntax, morphology, and semantics in Spanish, Fijian, and Shona using descriptive, typological, and corpus linguistics.
summary_zh: 研究语法、形态和语义的接口，使用描述性、类型学和语料库语言学方法，涉及西班牙语、斐济语和绍纳语。

name: David Corina
title: Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural mechanisms of language processing through behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理的认知和神经机制，使用行为和神经成像技术。

name: Jack Hawkins
title: Professor
summary: Studies language universals and typology from a processing perspective, focusing on English and the Germanic language family.
summary_zh: 研究语言共性与类型学从处理视角出发，专注于英语和日耳曼语系。

name: Masoud Jasbi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies linguistic meaning and language acquisition through computational models and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言意义和语言习得的计算模型和实验方法。

name: Laurie Lawyer
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain perceives and integrates word forms, using behavioral tasks, eye-tracking, and EEG in diverse linguistic populations.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何感知和整合词形，使用行为任务、眼动追踪和EEG在不同语言群体中的应用。

name: Emily Morgan
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies language comprehension through stored representations and online processing using psycho- and neurolinguistic methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言理解通过存储表示和在线处理使用心理语言学和神经语言学方法。

name: Kenji Sagae
title: Professor
areas: Computational linguistics and natural language processing
More publications available through Google Scholar
summary: Studies syntax and semantics using neural models and corpus methods, focusing on child language development.
summary_zh: 使用神经模型和语料库方法研究句法和语义，并关注儿童语言发展。

name: Rob Voigt
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social meaning, sociophonetics, and computational methods to address social problems like policing and immigration.
summary_zh: 研究社会意义、社会音系学以及使用计算方法解决警察制度、移民等问题。

name: Georgia Zellou
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonetics, speech perception, and laboratory phonology to understand how phonetic detail is represented by the cognitive system.
summary_zh: 研究音系学、语音感知和实验室语音学，以理解语音细节如何被认知系统表示。

name: Richard Futrell
title: Associate Professor of Language Science
summary: Studies language processing in humans and machines using information theory and Bayesian cognitive modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人类和机器的语言处理，使用信息论和贝叶斯认知建模方法。

name: Connor Mayer
title: Assistant Professor of Language Science
summary: Studies phonological and phonetic learning, phonotactic learning, Uyghur phonetics, and speech motor control using computational and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究音系和音位学习、音位学习、维吾尔语音位学以及发音控制和生物力学，采用计算和实验方法。

name: Lisa Pearl
title: Professor of Language Science
summary: Studies how children learn language using computational models and empirical data.
summary_zh: 研究儿童语言学习的计算模型和实证数据。

name: Gregory Scontras
title: Associate Professor of Language Science
summary: Studies the semantics of measurement, adjective ordering, and social inference through experiments and theoretical analysis.
summary_zh: 研究度量语义学、形容词排列和社会推理的实验和理论分析。

name: Mary Byram Washburn
title: Assistant Professor (Teaching) of Linguistics
summary: Studies tone and intonation in Bantu languages through fieldwork and acoustic analysis.
summary_zh: 研究班图语系的声调和语调通过实地考察和声学分析。

name: Dani Byrd
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonetics and phonology through USC Phonetics & Phonology Group.
summary_zh: 研究音系学并通过南加州大学音系学与音位学小组进行。

name: Zuzanna Fuchs
title: Ass0ciate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies noun categorization systems, including grammatical gender and noun classes, through psycholinguistic methods in monolingual and bilingual speakers.
summary_zh: 研究名词分类系统，包括语法性、名词类别等，通过心理语言学方法在单语和双语说话者中进行研究。

name: Louis Goldstein
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies speech production and articulation through phonetics and knowledge groups.
summary_zh: 研究发音生产和发音知识通过语音学和知识组。

name: Hajime Hoji
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies the language faculty through disconfirmable universal predictions and the hypothetico-deductive method.
summary_zh: 研究语言能力通过不可反驳的普遍预测和假设演绎方法。

name: Khalil Iskarous
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies laboratory phonology and motor control using dynamical systems analysis and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究实验室音系学和运动控制，使用动力系统分析和计算方法。

name: Elsi Kaiser
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies sentence processing, information structure, and reference resolution across various languages using psycholinguistic methods.
summary_zh: 研究句子处理、信息结构和参照解析，使用心理语言学方法跨多种语言进行研究。

name: Andrew Murphy
title: Assistant Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies syntactic theory and interfaces to syntax in various understudied languages.
summary_zh: 研究句法学及其与形态学、音系学和语义学的接口，特别是在未研究语言中的理论问题。

name: Deniz Rudin
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies semantics, pragmatics, and context update, focusing on how variation in context update effects derive from semantic interpretation.
summary_zh: 研究语义学、语用学和上下文更新，关注语义解释如何导致上下文更新效果的变化。

name: Barry Schein
title: Professor of Linguistics and Philosophy
summary: Studies semantics and philosophy of language through book chapters and journal articles.
summary_zh: 研究语义学和语言哲学，通过著作和期刊文章进行探讨。

name: Stephanie Shih
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonological interfaces and syntagmatic relationships in language through computational and corpus methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言的音系接口和句法关系，通过计算和语料库方法。

name: Toby Mintz
title: Professor of Psychology and Linguistics
summary: Studies language acquisition in infants and toddlers through cognitive mechanisms and syntactic knowledge development.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿的语言习得机制及其句法知识的发展。

name: Jason Zevin
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Linguistics
summary: Studies language processing and acquisition through cognitive neuroscience and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理和习得的认知神经科学和计算建模。

name: Andrew Simpson
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies syntax in East Asian, Southeast Asian, and South Asian languages through comparative analysis.
summary_zh: 研究东亚、东南亚和南亚语言的句法学，通过比较分析进行。

name: Matt Andersen
title: Associate Instructional Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies sign language pedagogy, Deaf aesthetics, and technology integration in Deaf education.
summary_zh: 研究手语教学、聋人美学和技术在聋人教育中的整合。

name: Karlos Arregi
title: Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College

summary_zh: 研究句法学和形态学及其与音系学和语义学的接口，主要使用巴斯克语、西班牙语和瓦什奥语的数据。

name: Melissa Baese-Berk
title: Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies spoken language understanding, production, and second-language acquisition through experimental and corpus-based methods.
summary_zh: 研究口头语言的理解、产生和第二语言习得，采用实验和语料库方法。

name: Canaan Breiss
title: Neubauer Family Assistant Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies phonological processes through computational and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究音系过程，采用计算和实验方法。

name: Diane K Brentari
title: Mary K. Werkman Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies sign language grammars of Deaf communities, focusing on structure and modality effects.
summary_zh: 研究聋人社区的手语语法，关注结构和模态效应。

name: Itamar Francez
title: Associate Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies semantics, pragmatics, and lexical, contextual factors influencing complex inferential behaviors, with a focus on Hebrew.
summary_zh: 研究语义学、语用学以及词汇、语境因素如何影响复杂的推理行为，特别是以希伯来语为例。

name: Susan Gal
title: Mae and Sidney G. Metzl Distinguished Service Professor in the Department of Anthropology, Department of Linguistics, and the College
summary: Studies language and culture through linguistic anthropology.
summary_zh: 研究语言和文化通过语言人类学。

name: Anastasia Giannakidou
title: Frank J. McLoraine Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies linguistic meaning, form-meaning relation, and language use for subjectivity across various languages including Greek, German, Dutch, Spanish, Basque, Korean, and Mandarin.
summary_zh: 研究语言意义、形式与意义的关系以及语言在表达主观性方面的使用，涉及多种语言如希腊语、德语、荷兰语、西班牙语、巴斯克语、韩语和汉语。

name: Lenore Grenoble
title: John Matthews Manly Distinguished Service Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies language contact and shift in Arctic Indigenous settings through fieldwork and documentation.
summary_zh: 研究北极土著语言接触和转移现象，通过实地工作和文献记录。

name: Christopher Kennedy
title: William H. Colvin Distinguished Service Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies the mapping of linguistic forms to meanings through comparison, amount and degree, and engages with syntax-semantics interface.
summary_zh: 研究语言形式与意义之间的映射，特别是比较、数量和程度，以及句法学与语义学的接口。

name: Sharese King
title: Associate Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies African American speech and its racialization through phonetic, ethnographic, and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究非洲裔美国人语言及其种族化现象，采用音系学、民族志和实验方法。

name: Alexandra Krauska
title: Assistant Instructional Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies language production and comprehension using psycho- and neuro-linguistic models, experimental methods, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究语言产生和理解的神经语言学模型、实验方法和计算建模。

name: Fidele Mpiranya
title: Instructional Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies African languages through descriptive and comparative methods.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言通过描述性和比较性方法。

name: Salikoko S Mufwene
title: Edward Carson Waller Distinguished Service Professor in the Department of Linguistics
summary: Studies the evolution of language through an ecological lens, focusing on the impact of colonization and globalization.
summary_zh: 研究语言的进化通过生态视角，重点关注殖民化和全球化的影响。

name: David J. E. Reinhart
title: Associate Instructional Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies American Sign Language pedagogy, curriculum development, and Deaf culture through teaching and collaboration.
summary_zh: 研究美国手语教学法、课程开发和聋人文化，通过教学和合作进行。

name: Jason Riggle
title: Associate Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies phonology, learnability, and computational linguistics to predict linguistic typology through model interactions.
summary_zh: 研究音系学、习得性和计算语言学，通过模型交互预测语言类型学。

name: Craig Thorburn
title: Assistant Instructional Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies speech sound categories learning through computational modeling, behavioral experiments, and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究语音类别学习通过计算建模、行为实验和神经影像学方法。

name: Ming Xiang
title: David B. and Clara E. Stern Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies sentence processing, syntax, semantics, and discourse comprehension with a focus on neural mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究句子处理、句法、语义和话语理解，关注神经机制的作用。

name: Erik Zyman
title: Assistant Professor in the Department of Linguistics and the College
summary: Studies syntactic structures and operations like Merge and constituency across languages including English, Latin, and P’urhepecha.
summary_zh: 研究句法结构和操作，如合并和成分性，涉及英语、拉丁语和P’urhepecha等语言。

name: Ann Bradlow
title: Abraham Harris Professor
summary: Studies acoustics and its applications in linguistics through research dissemination.
summary_zh: 研究声学及其在语言学中的应用并通过研究成果的传播.

name: Jennifer Cole
title: Professor
summary: Studies prosody in human languages through computational and statistical methods, focusing on intonation and temporal patterns.
summary_zh: 研究人类语言的音调和时间模式，采用计算和统计方法。

name: Annette D'Onofrio
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social identity is expressed through phonetic variables using sociolinguistic and psycholinguistic methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会身份如何通过音系变量表达，结合社会语言学和心理语言学的方法。

name: Matt Goldrick
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive mechanisms of linguistic knowledge and processing using behavioral experiments and formal models.
summary_zh: 研究语言认知机制及其处理过程，使用行为实验和形式模型。

name: Jiayi Lu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies syntactic adaptation and satiation through psycholinguistic experiments and theoretical models.
summary_zh: 研究句法适应和饱和现象的心理语言学实验和理论模型。

name: Eszter Ronai
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies sentence processing, scalar implicature, and information structure through psycholinguistic experiments.
summary_zh: 研究句子处理、标量含意和信息结构的心理语言学实验。

name: Gregory Ward
title: Professor
summary: Studies pragmatic theory, information structure, and reference through discourse/pragmatics research.
summary_zh: 研究语用理论、信息结构和指称，通过话语/语用学研究。

name: Sameer Ashaie
dept: Roxelyn and Richard Pepper Department of Communication Sciences and Disorders
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies aphasia rehabilitation, post-stroke depression, and emotion recognition using qualitative, quantitative, and psychophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究失语症康复、中风后抑郁和情绪识别，使用定性、定量和生理心理测量方法。

name: Bharath Chandrasekaran

title: Professor
areas: Language use and language shift in Indonesia
summary: Studies the interaction between phonology and phonetics in Austronesian languages through laboratory phonology, focusing on language use and language shift in Indonesia.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和音法学之间的互动，特别是在印度尼西亚的澳大利亚语系语言中的实验室音法学，关注语言使用和语言转移问题。

name: Miloje Despic
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies theoretical syntax, morphology, and semantics, focusing on cross-linguistic variation and the syntax-morphology interface.
summary_zh: 研究理论句法学、形态学和语义学，关注跨语言变异和句法-形态学界面。

name: Molly Diesing
title: Professor
summary: Studies syntax and the interface between syntax and semantics, focusing on Germanic languages, particularly German and Yiddish, and word order phenomena.
summary_zh: 研究句法学和句法与语义学的接口，特别是德语和雅利安语，以及词序现象。

name: Jennifer Kuo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the learning and representation of phonological paradigms, focusing on Austronesian languages through experimental and corpus methods.
summary_zh: 研究音系学中的模式学习和表示，重点关注通过实验和语料库方法的奥斯特尼语系语言。

name: Sarah Murray
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the semantics and pragmatics of natural language, focusing on formal representations needed for diverse linguistic structures across grammatically diverse languages.
summary_zh: 研究自然语言的语义和语用学，关注不同语言结构所需的正式表示形式。

name: Matilda Prestano
title: Faculty
summary: Studies ASL linguistics and De'VIA through direct instruction and community building.
summary_zh: 研究美国手语语言学和De'VIA，通过直接教学和社区建设。

name: Mats Rooth
title: Professor
summary: Studies the semantics of focus, ellipsis, and presupposition using computational and probabilistic models.
summary_zh: 研究焦点、省略和预设的语义，使用计算和概率模型。

name: Samuel Tilsen
title: Professor
summary: Studies speech production and phonological change through perception and articulation analysis.
summary_zh: 研究语音产生和音系变化，通过感知和发音分析进行探索。

name: Marten van Schijndel
title: Associate Professor
areas: Xenophobia meter aims to track anti-immigrant hate speech
summary: Studies linguistic processing using computational models and psycholinguistic methodologies, comparing human and neural network responses.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理的语言学表示，使用计算建模和心理语言学方法，比较人类和神经网络的反应。

name: Michael L Weiss
title: Richard J. Schwartz Professor in Social Sciences
areas: Historical phonology and morphology of Greek
New book helps students learn ancient Tocharian language
summary: Studies the historical phonology and morphology of Greek, Latin, and Sabellic languages, as well as Tocharian and Old Irish.
summary_zh: 研究希腊语、拉丁语和萨贝利克语言的历史音系和形态学，以及吐火罗语和古爱尔兰语。

name: John B. Whitman
title: Professor
summary: Studies the limits and predictors of language variation, focusing on syntax and historical linguistics of East Asian languages.
summary_zh: 研究语言变异的限度和预测因素，重点关注东亚语言的句法学和历史语言学。

name: Maya Ravindranath Abtahian
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies language variation and change in the context of language shift and social processes through sociolinguistic research.
summary_zh: 研究语言变异和社会过程中的语言转变，特别是移民、去工业化和语言濒危现象。

name: Ash Asudeh
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies morphology and a new theory called Lexical-Realizational Functional Grammar (LrFG) that combines Distributed Morphology and Lexical-Functional Grammar.
summary_zh: 研究形态学和一种新的理论——词汇-实现功能语法（LrFG），该理论结合了分布式形态学和词汇-功能语法。

name: C.M. Downey
title: Assistant Professor of Linguistics & Data Science
summary: Develops methods to improve Natural Language Processing (NLP) tools for under-resourced languages through unsupervised learning, multilingual modeling, and transfer learning.
summary_zh: 通过无监督学习、多语言建模和迁移学习改进低资源语言的自然语言处理（NLP）工具。

name: Nadine Grimm
title: James P. Wilmot Distinguished Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies grammatical tone systems and language contact in Bantu languages through fieldwork and documentation.
summary_zh: 研究班图语系的音系系统和语言接触，通过田野调查和文献记录进行研究。

name: Scott Grimm
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies how meaning is transferred through language and how grammars of the world’s languages are optimized to convey meaning through corpus-based approaches and experimental semantics.
summary_zh: 研究语言中意义的传递以及世界语言的语法如何优化以传达意义，通过语料库方法和实验语义学。

name: Joyce M. McDonough
title: Richard L. Turner Professor of Linguistics
areas: Neural Coding of Vowels (w Laurel Carney
summary: Studies the mental lexicon in complex morphological languages like Athabaskan through fieldwork and neural coding of vowels.
summary_zh: 研究复杂形态语言（如阿巴斯堪语）的心理词典，通过田野工作和元音的神经编码进行。

name: Asia Pietraszko
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies verbal morphosyntax in Bantu languages, focusing on clausal architecture and processes like selection and movement.
summary_zh: 研究班图语系动词形态语法，关注句法结构和选择、移动等过程。

name: Jeffrey T. Runner
title: Professor of Linguistics & Brain and Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies the time course of language comprehension using visual world eye-tracking, focusing on anaphoric expressions and their interactions with linguistic and visual context.
summary_zh: 使用视觉世界眼动追踪研究语言理解的时间进程，重点关注代词表达及其与语言和视觉上下文的交互作用。

name: Aaron White
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies the relationships between linguistic expressions and conceptual categories for building better natural language understanding systems.
summary_zh: 研究语言表达与概念范畴之间的关系，以构建更好的自然语言理解系统。

name: Gregg Castellucci
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies speech production, gesture and multimodal communication, and motor planning through analysis of animal behavior and neural circuits.
summary_zh: 研究语音产生、多模态交流和运动规划，通过分析动物行为和神经回路.

name: Coraline Rinn Iordan
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Brain and Cognitive Sciences, Neuroscience
summary: Studies visual and semantic cognition, learning, attention, and neuroplasticity using real-time fMRI and neurofeedback.
summary_zh: 研究视觉和语义认知、学习、注意和神经可塑性，使用实时fMRI和神经反馈技术。

name: T. Florian Jaeger
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor, Brain and Cognitive Sciences and Computer Science
areas: Models of human speech perception and production
summary: Studies human speech perception and production, adaptive language processing, and Bayesian inference through advanced statistical models.
summary_zh: 研究人类语音感知和产生、语言处理的适应性以及贝叶斯推理，通过高级多元和分布数据分析（GLMMs、GAMMs、NLMMs、混合模型等）。

name: Scott AnderBois
title: Program Director, Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies Indigenous languages in Latin America, focusing on pragmatics and semantics through community-engaged language documentation.
summary_zh: 研究拉丁美洲土著语言的语用学和语义学，通过参与式语言记录方法进行研究。

name: Uriel Cohen Priva
title: Associate Professor of Linguistics, Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies phonology and phonetics with information-theoretic approaches, focusing on language change and variation.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和语音学，采用信息论方法，关注语言变化和变异。

name: Pauline Jacobson
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies semantics, syntax, and pragmatics through compositional semantics, lexical semantics, and categorial grammar.
summary_zh: 研究语义学（组合语义学和词汇语义学）、句法学和语用学，通过范畴化语义学的方法。

name: Paja Faudree
title: Associate Professor of Anthropology, Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies language and medicine, indigenous cultures, and drug use in Latin America through linguistic anthropology.
summary_zh: 研究语言与医学、原住民文化以及拉丁美洲的药物使用通过语言人类学。

name: Roman Feiman
title: Thomas J. and Alice M. Tisch Assistant Professor of Cognitive, Linguistic, and Psychological Sciences, Assistant Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies language acquisition and processing through cognitive development and semantics.
summary_zh: 研究语言获得和加工，通过认知发展和语义学。

name: Masako Fidler
title: Professor of Slavic Studies, Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies sound symbolism in Czech and discourse analysis through corpus-assisted methods.
summary_zh: 研究捷克语中的拟声词及其在话语分析中的应用。

name: Richard Kimberly Heck
title: Professor of Philosophy, Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies philosophy of language, mind, logic, and mathematics, focusing on compositionality, demonstratives, and sense.
summary_zh: 研究语言哲学、心灵哲学、逻辑哲学和数学哲学，关注组合性、指示词和意义。

name: Ellie Pavlick
title: Briger Family Distinguished Associate Professor of Computer Science, Associate Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies natural language processing and computational linguistics through representations and models in AI.
summary_zh: 研究自然语言处理和计算语言学中的表示和模型在人工智能中的应用。

name: Lio Wong
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies language learning and use efficiency, subjective aspects of language, and cognitive processes through experiments and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究语言学习和使用效率、语言的主观方面以及认知过程，通过实验和计算模型进行探索。

name: Jonathan Barnes
title: Professor, Department of Linguistics
summary: Studies the dynamic mappings between acoustic signals and linguistic categories in speech, focusing on prosody and intonation.
summary_zh: 研究语音信号与语言范畴之间的动态映射，尤其是语调和语调方面的内容。

name: Elizabeth Coppock
title: Associate Professor, Department of Linguistics
summary: Studies semantics of natural language through phenomena like superlatives, object agreement, and cross-linguistic variation in quantity superlatives.
summary_zh: 研究自然语言语义，包括超级形容词、对象一致性和数量超级形容词的跨语言变体。

name: Daniel Erker
title: Associate Professor, Department of Linguistics and Department of Romance Studies
summary: Studies Spanish in Boston, focusing on sociolinguistic behavior and contact-induced language change through fieldwork and analysis.
summary_zh: 研究波士顿西班牙语的社会语言学行为和接触引起的语言变化，通过实地工作和分析进行研究。

name: Paul Hagstrom
title: Associate Professor, Department of Linguistics
summary: Studies syntax, semantics, and language acquisition through questions and interrogatives.
summary_zh: 研究句法、语义和语言习得，特别是疑问句和疑问形式。

name: Sophie Hao
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Linguistics and Faculty of Computing and Data Sciences
summary: Studies interpretability in NLP through probing, feature attribution, and linguistic evaluation.
summary_zh: 研究自然语言处理的可解释性，通过探针、特征归因和语言评估方法。

name: Najoung Kim
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Linguistics and Department of Computer Science
summary: Studies computational semantics/pragmatics and generalization in humans and machine learning models using computational and experimental linguistic methodologies.
summary_zh: 研究计算语义学/语用学和人类与机器学习模型的一般化，采用计算和实验语言学方法。

name: Kate Lynn Lindsey
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Linguistics
summary: Studies under-researched languages, particularly the Pahoturi River family, through documentation, phonological analysis, and corpus research.
summary_zh: 研究巴霍图河语言家族等未充分研究的语言，通过语言记录、音系分析和语料库研究。

name: Neil Myler
title: Associate Professor, Department of Linguistics
summary: Studies the architecture of grammar, focusing on morphophonology, semantics, and syntax in Quechua and isiXhosa through fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究语法结构，主要关注Quechua和isiXhosa中的形态音系学、语义学和句法学，通过田野工作进行探究。

name: Anthony Yacovone
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Linguistics
summary: Studies language development and sentence processing using neuroimaging, eye-tracking, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 使用神经成像、眼动追踪和计算建模研究语言发展和句子处理。

name: Marc Zender
title: Faculty
summary: Studies Mesoamerican languages and writing systems, reconstructing older stages and deciphering ancient scripts.
summary_zh: 研究中美洲语言和书写系统，重建早期阶段并破译古代文字。

name: Nathalie Dajko
title: Associate Professor of Anthropology & Linguistics
summary: Studies linguistic phenomena through anthropological methods.
summary_zh: 通过人类学方法研究语言现象。

name: Thomas Klingler
title: Associate Professor of French and Linguistics
summary: Studies French linguistics through various methods.
summary_zh: 研究法语语言学，采用多种方法。

name: Judith Maxwell
title: Louise Rebecca Schawe and Williedell Schawe Professor of Linguistics & Anthropology
summary: Studies Mayan languages, language revitalization, and Tunica language recovery through fieldwork, education, and collaboration with indigenous communities.
summary_zh: 研究玛雅语言、语言复兴以及图尼卡语言的恢复，通过田野调查、教育和与原住民社区的合作。

name: Yonatan Bisk
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies embodied AI, language grounding, and language-conditioned robotics to enable machines to interpret and act upon language in physical and social environments.
summary_zh: 研究具身人工智能、语言接地和语言条件化机器人学，以使机器能够理解和在物理和社会环境中执行语言。

name: Ralf Brown
title: Faculty
areas: Natural Language Processing and Computational Linguistics
summary: Develops machine translation and computational linguistics tools, focusing on example-based machine translation and low-resource languages.
summary_zh: 开发机器翻译和计算语言学工具，专注于基于例句的机器翻译和低资源语言。

name: Mona Diab
title: Institute Director, Full Professor, ACL Fellow
areas: Culturally aware generative AI modeling and Evaluation
Generative AI & Applied machine learning techniques
summary: Studies trustworthy NLP and responsible AI, particularly in low-resource and multilingual contexts, through controllable natural language generation and cross-lingual processing.
summary_zh: 研究可信赖的自然语言处理和负责任的人工智能，特别是在低资源和多语言环境中的可控自然语言生成和跨语言处理。

name: Robert Frederking
title: Faculty
summary: Develops machine translation and multilingual information processing techniques, integrating resources and deploying speech-to-speech translation systems.
summary_zh: 开发机器翻译和多语言信息处理技术，整合资源并部署语音到语音的翻译系统。

name: Daniel Fried
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Natural Language Processing and Computational Linguistics
summary: Studies conversational AI and code generation to enable better human-computer interaction through pragmatic and multimodal approaches.
summary_zh: 研究会话人工智能和代码生成，通过语用和多模态方法增强人机交互。

name: Daphne Ippolito
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the limitations and privacy/security issues of large language models in text generation.
summary_zh: 研究大型语言模型在文本生成中的局限性和隐私/安全问题。

name: Alon Lavie
title: Distinguished Career Professor, Director of MSAII Program
summary: Studies multilingual NLP, machine translation, and speech translation with a focus on evaluation, fairness, and ethics.
summary_zh: 研究多语言自然语言处理、机器翻译和语音翻译，并关注评估、公平性和伦理问题。

name: Lei Li
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops scalable multilingual machine translation systems and AI for drug discovery and protein design.
summary_zh: 开发可扩展的多语言机器翻译系统和药物发现及蛋白质设计的AI。

name: Louis-Philippe Morency
title: Leonardo Associate Professor of Computer Science
summary: Studies human communication dynamics and multimodal machine learning to build computational models for social interaction analysis.
summary_zh: 研究人类交际动力学和多模态机器学习，构建社会互动分析的计算模型。

name: Graham Neubig
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops natural language processing technologies, focusing on core NLP, multimodal language models, and unsupervised learning.
summary_zh: 开发自然语言处理技术，重点关注核心自然语言处理、多模态语言模型和无监督学习。

name: Eric Nyberg
title: Professor
summary: Develops natural language processing systems for education and information retrieval through question answering and text mining.
summary_zh: 开发自然语言处理系统，用于教育和信息检索，包括问题回答和文本挖掘。

name: Bhiksha Raj
title: Professor
summary: Studies machine learning, speech processing, and multimodal computing with applications in audio analysis and privacy-preserving models.
summary_zh: 研究机器学习、语音处理和多模态计算，应用于音频分析和隐私保护模型。

name: Carolyn P. Rosé
title: Kavčić-Moura Professor of Language Technologies and Human-Computer Interaction
summary: Studies the social and pragmatic nature of conversation to build computational systems that enhance conversation efficacy between people and computers.
summary_zh: 研究会话的社会和语用性质，以构建提高人与计算机之间会话有效性的计算系统。

name: Maarten Sap
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Toxicity and Cultural Awareness in Language
summary: Studies social biases and ethical implications in language technology through conversational AI and narrative analysis.
summary_zh: 研究语言技术中的社会偏见和伦理影响，通过对话式人工智能和叙事分析。

name: Emma Strubell
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies natural language processing for efficient and equitable AI through machine annotation and model assessment.
summary_zh: 研究高效和公平的自然语言处理（NLP），通过机器注释和模型评估。

name: Alexander Waibel
title: Professor (On Leave)
summary: Studies machine learning, speech processing, and spoken language translation through neural networks and multimodal computing.
summary_zh: 研究机器学习、语音处理和口语翻译，通过神经网络和多模态计算。

name: Shinji Watanabe
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies speech processing, including speech recognition, translation, and enhancement through neural models and open-source toolkits.
summary_zh: 研究语音处理，包括语音识别、翻译和增强，通过神经模型和开源工具包。

name: Sean Welleck
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops learning, inference, and evaluation algorithms for large language models, focusing on mathematical reasoning and code generation.
summary_zh: 开发大型语言模型的学习、推理和评估算法，特别是在数学推理和代码生成方面的应用。

name: Chenyan Xiong
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies large language models, information retrieval, and healthcare AI through data-centric approaches and efficient pretraining methods.
summary_zh: 研究大规模语言模型、信息检索和医疗AI，通过数据导向的方法和高效的预训练技术。

name: Yiming Yang
title: Professor
summary: Studies machine learning, natural language processing, and large language models through self-alignment, self-refinement, and inference-time reasoning.
summary_zh: 研究机器学习、自然语言处理和大型语言模型，通过自我对齐、自我完善和推理时的推理进行提升。

name: Seth Cable
title: Edward Sapir Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies the interface between formal semantic theory and field research, documenting and analyzing understudied languages.
summary_zh: 研究形式语义理论与田野研究的接口，记录和分析未研究过的语言。

name: Rajesh Bhatt
title: Professor & Graduate Program Director
summary: Studies syntax-semantics interface, Modern Indo-Aryan languages, and Tree Adjoining Grammars through comparative syntax and semantics.
summary_zh: 研究句法学-语义学接口、现代印欧语系语言和树邻接文法，通过比较句法和语义学。

name: Vincent Homer
title: Associate Professor, Honors Program Director & Undergraduate Program Co-Director
summary: Studies formal semantics, syntax, and pragmatics through theoretical analysis.
summary_zh: 研究形式语义学、句法学和语用学。

name: Magda Oiry
title: Faculty
areas: Prosody of wh-in situ in Long Distance questions
summary: Studies first and second language acquisition and French syntax, focusing on wh-in-situ and embedded clefts.
summary_zh: 研究第一语言和第二语言习得以及法语句法学，特别是wh-in-situ和嵌入式同位语。

name: Faruk Akkuş
title: Assistant Professor & Undergraduate Advisor
summary: Studies syntactic and semantic properties of implicit arguments in endangered languages through fieldwork on Arabic, Kurdish, and Turkish dialects.
summary_zh: 研究濒危语言中的隐含论元的句法学和语义学性质，通过田野调查收集阿拉伯语、库尔德语和土耳其语方言的数据。

name: Ana Arregui
title: Professor and TA/TO Coordinator
summary: Studies natural language semantics, focusing on modality, tense, aspect, pronouns, and indefinites, and their psycholinguistic processing.
summary_zh: 研究自然语言语义学，关注模态性、时态、方面、代词和不定代词，并探讨其心理语言学处理。

name: Michael Becker
title: Associate Professor, Undergraduate Advisor
areas: Phonological determinants of word formation processes
summary: Studies phonological determinants of word formation processes through experimental and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究音系学对词汇形成过程的决定因素，通过实验和计算方法。

name: María Biez
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how meanings are assembled and how structure and context influence pragmatic inferences.
summary_zh: 研究意义的构建以及结构和语境如何影响语用推断。

name: Brian Dillon
title: Professor, Cognitive Science of Language Lab Director, Graduate Admissions Chair & Undergraduate Advisor
summary: Studies how adults use cognitive resources like attention and memory when interpreting language through eye-tracking and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究成人如何在阅读时利用注意力和记忆等认知资源理解语言，使用眼动追踪和计算模型的方法。

name: Katrin Erk
title: Professor and Website Manager
summary: Studies flexible word meanings and narrative schemas in context through computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究语境中灵活的词义表示和叙事模式通过计算方法。

name: Lisa Green
title: Distinguished University Professor & Center for the Study of African American Languages (CSAAL) Director
areas: African American English syntax and semantics
summary: Studies syntax and syntactic variation in African American English, focusing on tense/aspect marking, negation, and language development.
summary_zh: 研究美国黑人英语（African American English）的句法和句法变体，重点关注时态/方面标记、否定以及语言发展。

name: Gaja Jarosz
title: Professor & Chair of Curriculum Committee
summary: Studies phonological theory and computational models of phonological learning in children.
summary_zh: 研究音系理论和计算模型在儿童音系学习中的应用。

name: Kyle Johnson
title: Professor, Undergraduate Recruitment and LINGLE Coordinator
summary: Studies syntactic theory through teaching and learning at multiple universities.
summary_zh: 研究句法学，曾在多所大学任教和学习。

name: John Kingston
title: Professor, Phonetics Lab Director, & Honors Program Coordinator
summary: Studies how listeners perceive speech and its impact on phonological representations and sound change through rigorous experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究听者对语音的感知及其对音系表征和音变的影响，采用严格的实验方法。

name: Shota Momma
title: Assistant Professor & TA Coordinator
summary: Studies sentence structure assembly for speaking in English and Japanese through psycholinguistic methods.
summary_zh: 研究英语和日语的句子结构构建过程，采用心理语言学方法。

name: Joe Pater
title: Professor and Co-Director of the Computational Phonology Laboratory and Chair of the Personnel Committee
summary: Studies phonology and language acquisition using weighted constraints for modeling and learning.
