name: Natasha Abner
title: Associate Professor, Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies semantics, syntax, and psycholinguistics through fieldwork and sign language research.
summary_zh: 研究语义学、句法学和心理语言学，通过田野工作和手语研究进行。

name: Steven Abney
title: Professor
summary: Studies computational linguistics, focusing on parsing, semi-supervised learning, and language documentation.
summary_zh: 研究计算语言学，特别是解析和半监督学习，以及语言记录。

name: Laura Aull
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of African languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和音位学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行。

name: William Baxter
title: Professor
summary: Studies the historical development of Chinese language and its dialects through linguistic reconstruction and methodology.
summary_zh: 研究汉语及其方言的历史发展，通过语言重建和方法论进行研究。

name: Julie Boland
title: Professor
summary: Studies word recognition, syntactic processing, and semantic processing in language comprehension through psycholinguistic methods.
summary_zh: 研究词汇识别、句法处理和语义处理在语言理解中的交互作用，采用心理语言学方法。

name: Jonathan Brennan
title: Professor
summary: Studies the mental structures and computations used in language comprehension through EEG, MEG, and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究语言理解中的心理结构和计算过程，使用EEG、MEG和fMRI进行神经成像。

name: Huteng Dai
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies phonetics and phonology using computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和音法学，使用计算方法。

name: San Duanmu
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonology and the interaction between phonology and morphosyntax through feature theory, syllable theory, and metrical theory.
summary_zh: 研究音系学及其与形态句法的交互，包括特征理论、音节理论和音步理论。

name: Minjee Kwon
dept: Department of Linguistics, Languages, and Cultures
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies linguistics through new faculty and staff members' perspectives.
summary_zh: 通过新教职员工的视角研究语言学。

name: Scott Borgeson
dept: Department of Linguistics, Languages, and Cultures
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies prosodic hierarchy, Estonian morphophonology, and phonological opacity through phonological analysis.
summary_zh: 研究音系层次、爱沙尼亚语形态音韵学和音系透明性。

name: Youngeun Kim
dept: Department of Linguistics, Languages, and Cultures
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies phonetics and phonology in Korean and English, speech perception in L2 learning, and learner-centered curricula design.
summary_zh: 研究韩语和英语的音系学与音法学，二语学习中的语音感知以及以学习者为中心的课程设计。

name: India Plough
dept: Department of Linguistics, Languages, and Cultures
title: is Associate Professor in the Residential College in the Arts and Humanities (RCAH)
summary: Studies the role of interactional competence and nonverbal behavior in second language speaking through qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究互动能力和非言语行为在第二语言口语中的作用，采用定性和定量方法。

name: Carrie Symons
dept: Department of Linguistics, Languages, and Cultures
title: is Assistant Professor of Literacy and Language in the Department of Teacher Education where she teach
summary: Studies the relationship between teachers' practices and immigrant-origin youth's literacy and language development in multilingual contexts.
summary_zh: 研究教师的教学实践与移民背景青少年在多语境中的语言和 literacy 发展之间的关系。

name: Koen Van Gorp
dept: Department of Linguistics, Languages, and Cultures
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies task-based language teaching and assessment, second language development, and multilingual education through research and policy.
summary_zh: 研究基于任务的语言教学与评估、二语发展以及多语教育。

name: Meagan Driver
dept: Department of Linguistics, Languages, and Cultures
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between emotions, motivation, and linguistic identity in heritage and second language acquisition through mixed-methods approaches.
summary_zh: 研究情感、动机和语言身份在母语和第二语言习得中的关系，采用混合方法。

name: Silvina Bongiovanni
dept: Department of Linguistics, Languages, and Cultures
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies phonological contrasts and sound patterns in Spanish through experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究西班牙语的音系特征和音系模式通过实验方法。

name: Peter De Costa
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of identity, ideology, and emotion in applied linguistics, including World Englishes and CLIL education.
summary_zh: 研究身份、意识形态和情感在应用语言学中的作用，包括世界英语和内容与语言整合教育。

name: Dustin De Felice
title: Professor, Director of the English Language Center
summary: Studies language teaching and learning through qualitative inquiries, especially Phenomenology, and investigates technology in traditional and virtual classrooms.
summary_zh: 研究语言教学和学习，特别是现象学的质性研究，以及技术在传统和虚拟课堂中的应用。

name: Senta Goertler
title: Professor
summary: Studies language education and technology-mediated learning to improve educational practices.
summary_zh: 研究语言教育和技术辅助学习，以改进教育实践。

name: Aline Godfroid
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes in second language acquisition using eye-tracking and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得中的认知过程，使用眼动追踪和定量方法。

name: Minjin Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies second language acquisition and computational approaches to language analysis through corpus linguistics and generative AI.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得和语言分析的计算方法，通过语料库语言学和生成式AI。

name: Amanda Lanier
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies intersections of culture and technology in language learning and teacher cognition, focusing on critical and heritage languages.
summary_zh: 研究文化和技术在语言学习和教师认知中的交叉点，特别是关键和母语语言。

name: Shawn Loewen
title: Professor, SLS Director
summary: Studies instructed second language acquisition, classroom interaction, and mobile-assisted language learning through research and publications.
summary_zh: 研究指导二语习得、课堂互动和移动辅助语言学习。

name: Charlene Polio
title: Professor
summary: Studies second language writing and corpus-based analyses of published research.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言写作和出版研究的语料库分析。

name: Frederick Poole
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the role of games in language learning and digital literacy through teaching and research.
summary_zh: 研究游戏在语言学习中的作用以及数字素养。

name: Bruna Sommer-Farias
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies genre-based writing instruction in second languages and its benefits for first language writing.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言中的体裁写作教学及其对第一语言写作的益处。

name: Paula Winke
title: Professor
summary: Studies second language assessment and individual differences affecting language assessment processes and outcomes through various research methods.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言评估及其过程和结果中个体差异的影响，采用多种研究方法。

name: Michael Adams
title: Provost Professor, English
summary: Studies the history, theory, and practice of lexicography, focusing on regional English variation, slang, and linguistic creativity.
summary_zh: 研究词汇学的历史、理论和实践，特别是英语方言、俚语和语言创造力。

name: Patrícia Amaral
title: Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies how lexical, contextual, and pragmatic factors affect meaning through experimental and corpus analysis methods.
summary_zh: 研究词汇、语境和语用因素如何影响意义，并采用语料库分析和实验方法。

name: Kelly Berkson
title: Associate Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies phonetics, phonology, and language documentation through field linguistics and typology.
summary_zh: 研究音系学、音法学和语言记录，通过实地语言学和类型学方法。

name: Damir Cavar
title: Associate Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies computational linguistics and natural language processing through speech and language technologies.
summary_zh: 研究计算语言学和自然语言处理，通过语音和语言技术。

name: Malgorzata Cavar
title: Associate Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies laboratory phonology, L2 acquisition, and theoretical phonology through linguistic analysis.
summary_zh: 研究实验室音系学、二语习得和理论音系学。

name: Shobhana Chelliah
title: Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies Trans-Himalayan languages and low-resourced languages through documentary linguistics and corpus linguistics.
summary_zh: 研究喜马拉雅语系语言和低资源语言的音系学和语料库语言学。

name: Kenneth de Jong
title: Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies phonological systems through experimental approaches, focusing on second language acquisition and historical dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究音系系统，采用实验方法，关注第二语言习得和历史演变。

name: Laurent Dekydtspotter
title: Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies syntactic and semantic processing in second language acquisition through neural and electrophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得中的句法和语义处理，采用神经和电生理方法。

name: Debra Friedman
title: Associate Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies language learning and teaching in classroom settings through qualitative methods, focusing on language socialization and second language writing research.
summary_zh: 研究课堂语言学习和教学，通过质性方法，关注语言社会化和第二语言写作研究。

name: Luke Gessler
title: Assistant Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies low-resource natural language processing and computational language resources.
summary_zh: 研究低资源自然语言处理和计算语言资源。

name: Thomas Grano
title: Associate Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies semantics and syntax-semantics interface with cross-linguistic variation, focusing on attitude reports, mood, and modality.
summary_zh: 研究语义学和句法语义学界面，关注态度报告、情态和比较的跨语言变体。

name: Emily Hanink
title: Assistant Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies syntax and its interfaces with semantics and morphology through fieldwork on indigenous languages of North America and South-Central Tibeto-Burman (Chin) languages.
summary_zh: 研究句法学及其与语义学和形态学的接口，通过田野调查研究北美原住民语言和南中喜马拉雅语系（钦语）语言。

name: Sandra Kübler
title: Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies computational linguistics and natural language processing using machine learning techniques.
summary_zh: 研究计算语言学和自然语言处理，使用机器学习技术。

name: Monica Nesbitt
title: Assistant Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies African languages and linguistics, focusing on second language acquisition and psycho- and neurolinguistics.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言和语言学，侧重于第二语言习得和心理-神经语言学。

name: Samuel Gyasi Obeng
title: Distinguished Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies conversational phonetics and onomasiology in African languages through conversation analytic methodology.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的会话音系学和语词学，通过会话分析方法论进行探讨。

name: Kevin Rottet
title: Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies French linguistics through phonology and syntax.
summary_zh: 研究法语音系学和句法学。

name: Sun-Young Shin
title: Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies language assessment through developing and validating authentic listening, writing, and vocabulary tests.
summary_zh: 研究语言评估，通过开发和验证真实听力、写作和词汇测试。

name: Shuju Shi
title: Assistant professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies speech information processing, acoustic phonetics, and language acquisition through computer-aided methods.
summary_zh: 研究语音信息处理、声学音位学和语言习得，采用计算机辅助方法。

name: Rex A. Sprouse
title: Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies non-native language acquisition, focusing on phonology and Universal Grammar principles, with recent work on third language acquisition.
summary_zh: 研究非母语习得，特别是音系学和普遍语法原则，近期关注第三语言习得。

name: David Stringer
title: Associate Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Spanish dialects through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究西班牙语方言的音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行。

name: Francis M. Tyers
title: Associate Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies marginalized languages and morphosyntax using computational methods like machine translation and dependency parsing.
summary_zh: 研究边缘语言和形态句法，使用计算语言学方法如机器翻译和依存句法分析。

name: Barbara S. Vance
title: Associate Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies syntactic changes in French over 1200 years, focusing on word order and sentence relations.
summary_zh: 研究法语语法变化，重点关注词序和句法关系在1200年历史中的演变。

name: Yucel Yilmaz
title: Professor, Linguistics
summary: Studies the effects of corrective feedback and cognitive aptitudes on second language acquisition through various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究纠错反馈和认知能力对二语习得的影响，采用多种实验方法。

name: Leslie Del Carpio
title: Assistant Professor, Spanish and Portuguese
summary: Studies Spanish linguistics through phonological and morphosyntactic analysis.
summary_zh: 研究西班牙语音系学和形态句法学。

name: Manuel Díaz-Campos
title: Professor, Spanish and Portuguese
summary: Studies Spanish and Portuguese through phonology and morphology.
summary_zh: 研究西班牙语和葡萄牙语的音系学和形态学。

name: J. César Félix-Brasdefer
title: Professor, Spanish and Portuguese
summary: Studies pragmatics and second language pragmatics through discourse analysis and instruction.
summary_zh: 研究语用学和第二语言语用学，通过话语分析和教学进行探讨。

name: Laura Gurzynski-Weiss
title: Professor, Spanish and Portuguese
summary: Studies second language acquisition in classroom settings through cognitive-interactionist and usage-based frameworks.
summary_zh: 研究课堂环境中的第二语言习得，通过认知互动主义和使用主义框架。

name: M. Gabriela Pusca
title: Assistant Professor, Spanish and Portuguese
summary: Studies Spanish and Portuguese languages through linguistic analysis.
summary_zh: 研究西班牙语和葡萄牙语的语言学分析。

name: Erik W. Willis
title: Associate Professor, Spanish and Portuguese
summary: Studies Spanish phonology through experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究西班牙语音系学通过实验方法。

name: Julie Anderson
dept: Department of Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
title: Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies speech disfluencies through laboratory research.
summary_zh: 研究言语中断通过实验室研究。

name: Tessa Bent
dept: Department of Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
title: Provost Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies children's and adult's perception of speech accents and barriers in healthcare communication through active-learning methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人对口音语音感知以及医疗保健沟通中的障碍，采用主动学习方法。

name: Ishanti Gangopadhyay
dept: Department of Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies language development and disorders, particularly in monolingual and bilingual children, using cognitive and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言发展和障碍，特别是在单语和双语儿童中的认知和实验方法。

name: Steven Lulich
dept: Department of Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies speech production and modeling using 3D/4D ultrasound imaging techniques to explore the intersection of anatomy, articulation, acoustics, and aerodynamics in phonological systems.
summary_zh: 研究发音生产与建模，使用3D/4D超声成像技术探索解剖学、发音、声学和气动学在音系系统中的交集。

name: Carol Mesa
dept: Department of Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies the effects of literacy interventions on bilingual children's reading skills through randomized controlled trials and single-subject designs.
summary_zh: 研究双语儿童阅读技能的干预效果，通过随机对照试验和单被试设计进行。

name: Rita Patel
dept: Department of Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies vocal physiology and voice production in normal and disordered voice across the lifespan, focusing on pediatric vocal development and spasmodic dysphonia.
summary_zh: 研究正常和异常声音的发音生理学，特别是在儿童声音发展和痉挛性失声症方面的研究。

name: Caroline Spencer
dept: Department of Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies speech production and neural mechanisms in disorders through behavioral and neurological approaches.
summary_zh: 研究言语产生和神经机制在障碍中的表现和神经学方法。

name: Rakesh Mohan Bhatt
title: Professor
summary: Studies migration, minorities, and multilingualism, focusing on language contact and code-switching in South Asian languages like Kashmiri and Hindi.
summary_zh: 研究移民、少数群体和多语言主义，关注南亚语言如克什米尔语和印地语中的语言接触和代码转换。

name: Jonathan Dunn
title: Associate Professor, Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies how grammar emerges and varies across populations through computational experiments and large multi-lingual corpora.
summary_zh: 研究语法如何在个体和群体中涌现和变化，通过计算实验和大型多语言语料库。

name: Susan Faivre
title: Faculty
summary: Develops policies and instructional strategies for ethical and effective use of generative AI in the classroom.
summary_zh: 制定伦理和有效使用生成式AI的教学策略和政策。

name: José Ignacio Hualde
title: Professor of Spanish and Linguistics
summary: Studies sound change, phonology, and historical linguistics of Romance and Basque languages through phonetic analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究罗曼语和巴斯克语的音系学和历史语言学，通过音系分析和田野调查进行研究。

name: Tania Ionin
title: Professor, Department Head
areas: Program in Jewish Culture and Society
summary: Studies second language acquisition and experimental semantics through intervention research and syntax/semantics interface analysis.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得和实验语义学，通过干预研究和句法学与语义学界面分析。

name: Jonathan E. MacDonald
title: Associate Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies syntactic theory and inner aspect in Romance languages through comparative analysis and formal approaches.
summary_zh: 研究罗曼语系语言的句法学和内方面通过比较分析和形式方法。

name: Aleksandre Maskharashvili
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies syntax, semantics, and discourse using formal and neural approaches.
summary_zh: 研究句法学、语义学和话语学，采用形式化和神经网络方法。

name: Anna Mendoza
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Literacy and Second Language Learning for Adults (LESLLA
summary: Studies literacy and second language learning for adults through classroom discourse analysis and qualitative research.
summary_zh: 研究成人第二语言学习和读写能力，通过课堂话语分析和质性研究。

name: Silvina Montrul
title: Professor of Spanish and Linguistics, Associate Department Head
summary: Studies second language acquisition, bilingualism, and heritage language learning through psycholinguistic methods.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得、双语主义和母语传承语言学习的语言学理论和心理语言学方法。

name: Scott Nelson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies phonetics-phonology interface and computational phonology through model-theoretic and production models.
summary_zh: 研究音系学与音位学接口以及计算音位学，通过模型理论和生产模型。

name: Randall W Sadler
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of technology, particularly telecollaboration and virtual worlds, in language learning.
summary_zh: 研究技术，尤其是远程协作和虚拟世界，在语言学习中的作用。

name: Ryan Keith Shosted
title: Professor
summary: Studies how phonetic principles shape phonological, typological, and diachronic outcomes in diverse languages using acoustics, kinematics, and aerodynamics.
summary_zh: 研究语音原理如何塑造语音学、类型学和历时演变结果，使用声学、运动学和空气动力学方法研究多种语言。

name: Karina Tachihara
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how cognitive mechanisms affect language learning, particularly unacceptability judgments and semantic knowledge, using psycholinguistic tasks and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究认知机制如何影响语言学习，特别是不接受性判断和语义知识，使用心理语言学任务和机器学习。

name: Aida Talić
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies syntax, comparative syntax, phonology, and syntax-prosody interface in Slavic languages through theoretical and empirical research.
summary_zh: 研究斯拉夫语言的句法学、比较句法学、音系学和句法-音系界面。

name: Yan Tang
title: Associate Professor
areas: Computational modelling of speech perception in noise
summary: Studies speech intelligibility enhancement and computational modelling of speech perception in noise through signal processing and automatic speech recognition.
summary_zh: 研究噪声条件下的语音清晰度增强和语音感知的计算建模，通过信号处理和自动语音识别方法。

name: Anastasia Tsilia
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies semantics, syntax-semantics interface, and pragmatics through academic research and testing.
summary_zh: 研究语义学、句法-语义学接口和语用学。

name: Xun Yan
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies speaking and writing assessment, scale development, rater behavior, and test score use in educational settings.
summary_zh: 研究口语和书面语评估、量表开发、评分者行为以及考试分数在教育环境中的应用。

name: James Hye Suk Yoon
title: Professor
summary: Studies syntax, morphology, and second language acquisition, focusing on Korean and Japanese linguistics.
summary_zh: 研究句法学、形态学和二语习得，专注于韩语和日语语言学。

name: Melissa A Bowles
title: Head, Professor
summary: Studies second language and heritage language acquisition through classroom and testing methods.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言和母语使用者语言习得，通过课堂和测试方法。

name: Salvatore Callesano
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies language in U.S. Latinx communities, sociolinguistics, and bilingualism through perceptual dialectology and social media analysis.
summary_zh: 研究美国拉丁裔社区的语言、社会语言学和双语现象，通过感知方言学和社交媒体分析。

name: Rodrigo Delgado
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies bilingualism and code-switching in Spanish and English, focusing on acceptability judgments and social variation.
summary_zh: 研究西班牙语和英语双语主义及代码转换，关注可接受性判断和社会变异。

name: Florencia Henshaw
title: Faculty
summary: Studies second language acquisition and pedagogy, focusing on Spanish through technology integration and classroom instruction.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得和教学，侧重于通过技术整合和课堂教学教授西班牙语。

name: Jill Jegerski
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies second language acquisition and online processing of Spanish as a heritage language using psycholinguistic methods.
summary_zh: 研究西班牙语作为母语的第二语言习得及其在线处理，使用心理语言学方法。

name: Joyce Tolliver
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies narratives and rhetorical analysis of gender and sexuality in Iberian literatures and global Hispanophone writings.
summary_zh: 研究伊比利亚文学和全球西语国家文本中的叙事和修辞分析，关注性别与性少数群体研究。

name: Anna Torres-Cacoullos
title: Assistant Professor

dept: Second Language Acquisition and Teaching Program
title: SLAT Graduate Advisor/DGS, Professor (On sabbatical Fall 2026)
summary: Studies second language writing, genre and discourse, English for Academic Purposes, and the politics of English in institutional contexts.
summary_zh: 研究二语写作、体裁与话语、学术英语以及英语在机构中的政治问题。

name: M'Balia Thomas
dept: Second Language Acquisition and Teaching Program
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies ideologies about language and language learning through qualitative methods, including arts-based research and digital humanities.
summary_zh: 研究语言和语言学习中的意识形态，通过质性研究方法，包括艺术基础研究和数字人文。

name: Chantelle Warner
dept: Second Language Acquisition and Teaching Program
title: Professor
summary: Studies the aesthetic and experiential dimensions of language teaching and learning, multiliteracies pedagogies, and the pragmatic aspects of literary testimony.
summary_zh: 研究语言教学和学习中的美学和体验维度、多文类教学法以及文学证词的语用方面。

name: Sunyoung Yang
dept: Second Language Acquisition and Teaching Program
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the influence of new media and digital technologies on society, focusing on youth, labor, and gender issues in Korea and East Asia.
summary_zh: 研究新媒体和数字技术对社会的影响，重点关注韩国和东亚地区的青年、劳动和性别问题。

name: Qing Zhang
dept: Second Language Acquisition and Teaching Program
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the role of language in social change and globalization in China through ethnographic and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言在中国社会变革和全球化中的作用，采用民族志和定量方法。

name: Lee Bebout
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Professor
summary: Studies language and identity through political and cultural narratives.
summary_zh: 研究语言和身份通过政治与文化叙事。

name: Robert Bjork
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Professor
summary: Studies Old English literature, particularly the Anglo-Saxon period, with interests in Scandinavian studies and medical writing.
summary_zh: 研究盎格鲁-撒克逊时期的英语文学，尤其是中世纪文学，同时对斯堪的纳维亚研究和医学写作感兴趣。

name: Natalie Diaz
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Professor
summary: Studies Native and Indigenous languages through documentation and poetry.
summary_zh: 研究原住民和土著语言并通过记录和诗歌进行研究。

name: Jessica Early
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Director of English Education, Professor
summary: Studies writing practices and teacher preparation in diverse secondary classrooms through qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究多元二次英语课堂中的写作实践和教师培训，采用定性和定量方法。

name: Jonathan Hope
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Publisher, Managing Editor, and Professor
summary: Studies Early Modern English texts, especially Shakespeare, using historical linguistics, corpus linguistics, and digital humanities techniques.
summary_zh: 研究早期现代英语文本，尤其是莎士比亚，使用历史语言学、语料库语言学和数字人文技术。

name: Elizabeth Horan
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Professor
summary: Studies the literary and biographical works of women writers, particularly Gabriela Mistral, through archival research and translation.
summary_zh: 研究女性作家，尤其是米斯特拉尔的文学和传记作品，通过档案研究和翻译进行。

name: Aya Matsuda
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Professor
summary: Studies the use of English as an international language and its pedagogical implications in World Englishes.
summary_zh: 研究英语作为国际语言的使用及其在全球英语中的教学意义。
kw: teaching english as an international language

name: Paul Matsuda
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Professor
summary: Studies second language writing, integrating insights from language studies and writing studies through various publications and editorial work.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言写作，结合语言学和写作学的理论与方法，通过多种出版物和编辑工作进行跨学科整合。

name: Matthew Prior
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Associate Chair (BPC), Professor
summary: Studies the relationships between language and emotion, focusing on identity, belonging, and well-being in digital contexts through conversation analysis and discursive psychology.
summary_zh: 研究语言与情感之间的关系，特别是在数字环境中如何构建和管理身份、归属感、心理健康和福祉，通过会话分析和话语心理学的方法。

name: Bryan Smith
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Director of the CALL Certificate, Professor
summary: Studies the intersection of computer-assisted language learning (CALL) and second language acquisition through eye-tracking technology and task-based learning.
summary_zh: 研究计算机辅助语言学习（CALL）与第二语言习得的交集，通过眼动追踪技术和任务型学习。

name: Peter Goggin
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies rhetorics and discourses of sustainability and globalization in oceanic islands through field research and publication.
summary_zh: 研究可持续性和全球化在海洋岛屿中的修辞和话语，通过实地研究和出版物进行探讨。

name: Mark James
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Director of Linguistics and Applied Linguistics, Associate Professor
summary: Studies learning transfer in second language education, exploring factors that influence and promote the application of second language skills in novel situations.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言教育中的学习转移，探索影响和促进第二语言技能在新情境中应用的因素。

name: Joe Lockard
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies antislavery literature and human rights philosophy in 19th-century American literature through digital humanities and translation initiatives.
summary_zh: 研究19世纪美国废奴文学和人权哲学，通过数字人文和翻译项目进行。

name: Tyler Peterson
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the documentation, revitalization, and maintenance of endangered Indigenous languages in the Americas and Oceania, focusing on the use of technology and media in language learning.
summary_zh: 研究美洲和大洋洲濒危原住民语言的记录、复兴和维护，重点关注技术与媒体在语言学习中的应用。

name: Christina Saidy
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Director of Graduate Studies, Associate Professor
summary: Studies writing transitions and teacher development for secondary and college students through case studies and policy analysis.
summary_zh: 研究中学生和大学生写作过渡及教师发展，通过案例研究和政策分析。

name: Gabriel Acevedo
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies queer and decolonial literacies, bilingualism, and young adult literature in Puerto Rico through qualitative methods and autoethnography.
summary_zh: 研究加勒比海普鲁士罗语系、双语主义和青少年文学中的同性恋和解殖民读写通过质性研究和自传性研究。

name: Reza Dalman
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies second language assessment, speech perception and production, and acquisition using quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言评估、语音感知与生产以及获得，采用定量方法。

name: Shahar Shirtz
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the grammatical and lexical means of expressing discourse functions in underdescribed languages like Alsea, Siuslaw, and Yuman, using constructional models and typological comparisons.
summary_zh: 研究不同语言中表达话语功能的语法和词汇手段，特别是俄勒冈海岸的语言如阿塞拉、西斯劳和尤曼语，采用构式模型和类型学比较的方法。

name: Peter Joseph Torres
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the use of artificial intelligence in language teaching and the impact of modality in policies related to the opioid crisis.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能在语言教学中的应用以及模态在阿片危机政策中的影响。

name: Ruby Macksoud
dept: Department of English (Linguistics and Applied Linguistics)
title: Faculty
summary: Studies TESOL and applied linguistics, focusing on skills development and experiential learning.
summary_zh: 研究英语作为第二语言（TESOL）和应用语言学，侧重于技能发展和体验式学习。

summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得和语言教学方法，通过实证研究进行探索。

summary_zh: 研究语言障碍和交流通过临床研究和理论分析。

summary_zh: 研究语言习得和教学方法的应用语言学研究。

summary: Studies the languages of South America, focusing on grammatical relations, kinship terminology, and historical linguistics through comparative and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究南美洲语言的语法关系、亲属称谓系统以及通过比较和计算方法的历史语言学。

name: Melvatha R. Chee
title: Associate Professor

summary_zh: 研究纳瓦霍语的第一语言习得和语料库构建，重点关注动词形态和第一语言学习。

name: Stefon Flego
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how language use influences phonological evolution through phonological contrast and information-theoretic factors.
summary_zh: 研究语言使用如何影响音系演变，通过音系对比和信息论因素。

name: Holly Jacobson

areas: Impact of language on healthcare access

summary_zh: 研究语言对医疗保健准入和健康不平等的影响，通过健康话语和跨文化医疗沟通。

name: Christian Koops
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies language and dialect contact phenomena, particularly Spanish-influenced English and New Mexican Spanish, using sociophonetic methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言和方言接触现象，特别是西班牙语影响下的英语和新墨西哥西班牙语，使用社会音韵学方法。

name: Celso Martinez
title: Faculty

summary_zh: 研究语言学现象，采用多种方法。

name: Jill Morford
title: Professor
summary: Studies language acquisition and processing in the visual modality, focusing on bilingualism in the Deaf community and the effects of language input on language development.
summary_zh: 研究视觉模态中的语言习得和处理，特别是聋人社区的双语主义以及语言输入对语言发展的影响。

name: Naomi Shin
title: Professor
summary: Studies child language acquisition and bilingualism, focusing on morphosyntactic variation and sociolinguistic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究儿童语言习得和双语主义，关注形态句法变体和社会语言学方法。

name: Erin Wilkinson

name: J Calder
title: Associate Professor

summary_zh: 研究边缘社区中的音变现象，通过社会音韵学和民族志方法探索其在构建边缘化身份中的作用。

name: Andrew Cowell
title: Professor

summary_zh: 研究阿罗哈霍语和波利尼西亚语的语言记录和词汇数据库开发。

name: Ambrocio Gutiérrez Lorenzo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies syntax and semantics of Zapotec languages through descriptive and documentary methods.
summary_zh: 研究墨西哥南部扎波特克语系语言的句法学和语义学，采用描述性和文献性方法。

name: Kira Hall

summary_zh: 研究印度性别非典型社群的语言实践，特别是印地语、英语和海英语，并探讨语言与神经多样性。

name: Hannah Haynie
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies linguistic diversity and language change in North American languages using methods from geography, ecology, and evolutionary biology.
summary_zh: 研究北美语言的语言多样性及语言变化，采用地理学、生态学和进化生物学的方法。

name: Laura Michaelis
title: Professor
summary: Studies tense-aspect interface, corpus syntax, and semantic change using Construction Grammar.
summary_zh: 研究时体接口、语料库句法和语义变化，使用构式语法。

name: Bhuvana Narasimhan
title: Professor

summary_zh: 研究语言获得和语言认知接口的语言库和实验研究。

name: Alexis Palmer

summary_zh: 研究计算话语和语义学、低资源语言以及社交媒体中的冒犯性语言自动检测。

name: Chase Wesley Raymond
title: Associate Professor

summary_zh: 研究社会语境中的语言使用，特别是美国拉丁裔和西班牙语使用者的经验，通过会话分析和社会语言学的方法。

name: Rebecca Scarborough
title: Associate Professor

summary_zh: 研究语音音系中的系统性变异，特别是鼻音连音，通过声学分析和感知实验进行探索。

dept: Department of Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences

summary_zh: 研究言语障碍中的语调和听觉反馈。

name: Christine Brennan
dept: Department of Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences

summary_zh: 研究罕见神经发育障碍的沟通和语言表现，特别是史蒂文-麦格尼思综合症和桑菲利波综合症，通过转化研究和人工智能干预。

name: Christina Meyers
dept: Department of Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies child language development and intervention methods for typical and atypical communication skills through clinical and research projects.
summary_zh: 研究儿童语言发展和干预方法，涵盖典型和异常沟通技能。

name: Donghyeon Yun
dept: Department of Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies speech perception and hearing technologies to improve intelligibility for listeners with hearing loss through psychoacoustics and signal processing.
summary_zh: 研究听力技术和心理声学以提高听力损失患者的语音可懂度。

name: Shannon Barrios

summary_zh: 研究语言习得通过斯皮奇获取实验室的实验。

summary_zh: 研究语言教学中的内容与语言整合模型、语言教师教育以及神经语言学。

summary_zh: 研究匈牙利语的音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行。

name: Rachel Hayes-harb

name: Yang Wang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in East Asian languages through corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究东亚语言的音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析进行。

name: Guillem Belmar Viernes
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies language revitalization, maintenance, and documentation in minority multilingual contexts through social media and indigenous diaspora research.
summary_zh: 研究少数语言的复兴、维持和记录，特别是在少数民族多语环境中的社会媒体和土著 diaspora 研究。

name: Don Daniels
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies language change, comparative reconstruction, and morphosyntax in Papuan languages through fieldwork and historical analysis.
summary_zh: 研究语言变化、比较重建和形态句法的音系学和历史语言学。

name: Spike Gildea

summary_zh: 研究亚马逊地区的语言，尤其是Werikyana语言，通过描述性和文献性的田野工作，以及历史句法学和音系学。

name: Nika Jurov

summary_zh: 研究语音及其认知和神经方面的特征，采用计算方法。

name: Vsevolod Kapatsinski

name: Gabriela Pérez Báez

name: Melissa Redford

summary_zh: 研究儿童口语生成，关注语音表征及其发展。

name: Emily M. Bender

name: Betsy Evans

summary_zh: 研究语言和社会，关注语言变异的态度和语言意识形态。

summary_zh: 研究语言使用中的变异通过社会语言学方法。

name: Naja Ferjan Ramírez
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies linguistic and brain growth variability in young children using home and laboratory recordings, MEG, and behavioral measures.
summary_zh: 研究儿童语言和大脑发展变异性的音系学和句法学，使用家庭和实验室录音、MEG 和行为语言测量方法。

name: Speech Perception
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies speech perception through experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究语音感知通过实验方法。

name: Speech Processing
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies speech processing through various methods.
summary_zh: 研究语音处理的各种方法。

name: Lance Forshay
title: Faculty
summary: Studies ASL verb morphology and fingerspelling phonology through Deaf culture studies.
summary_zh: 研究手语动词形态学和手指拼写音系学，通过聋人文化研究。

name: Andrew Hedding
title: Assistant Professor and Graduate Program Coordinator
summary: Studies information structure, focusing on syntactic focus movement and the interpretation of wh-words in Mixtec.
summary_zh: 研究信息结构，特别是句法焦点移动以及米斯特克语中疑问代词的语义解释。

name: Gina-Anne Levow
title: Professor
summary: Studies low-density languages, natural language processing, and prosody through computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究低密度语言、自然语言处理和语调，采用计算方法。

name: Dan Mathis
title: Faculty
summary: Studies language acquisition through child-directed speech and conversational turn-taking.
summary_zh: 研究语言习得通过儿童定向言语和对话轮换。

name: Laura McGarrity
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonology and phonological theory, particularly Optimality Theory and prosodic stress systems in various languages and children's phonological acquisition.
summary_zh: 研究音系学，尤其是优化理论和世界语言中的语调系统，以及儿童的音位习得。

name: Toshiyuki Ogihara
title: Professor
summary: Studies formal semantics of natural language, focusing on tense, aspect, modality, and conditionals in English and Japanese.
summary_zh: 研究自然语言的形式语义学，专注于英语和日语中的时态、方面、模态和条件句。

name: Amandalynne Paullada
title: Acting Assistant Professor
summary: Studies computational linguistics through computational methods and tools.
summary_zh: 研究计算语言学通过计算方法和技术。

name: Machine Learning
title: Acting Assistant Professor
summary: Studies linguistic phenomena using machine learning methods.
summary_zh: 使用机器学习方法研究语言现象。

name: Shane Steinert-Threlkeld
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies unsupervised natural language segmentation using computational linguistics methods.
summary_zh: 研究无监督自然语言分段，使用计算语言学方法。

name: Alicia Beckford Wassink
title: Professor
summary: Studies sociolinguistics and phonetics, focusing on language in social contexts and acoustic properties of speech, particularly in Jamaican Creole and Pacific Northwest English.
summary_zh: 研究社会语言学和音系学，特别是在 Jamaican 创造语和社会语境中的语言以及英语太平洋西北地区的语音属性。

name: Zachary Wellstood
title: Acting Assistant Professor
summary: Studies linguistics through various methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言学，采用多种方法。

name: Richard Wright
title: Professor
summary: Studies systematic variation in language production and perception, focusing on phonetics and prosody, with applications in speech technology and clinical hearing loss.
summary_zh: 研究语言生产与感知中的系统性变异，重点在于音系学和语调，应用于语音技术及听力损失临床研究。

name: Fei Xia
title: Professor
summary: Studies natural language processing tasks including morphological analysis and machine translation.
summary_zh: 研究自然语言处理任务，包括形态分析和机器翻译。

name: Gabriel Cler
dept: Department of Speech and Hearing Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies speech and hearing through computational neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究语音和听力通过计算神经科学方法。

name: Tanya Eadie
dept: Department of Speech and Hearing Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies vocal impairment and voice disorders through physiologic, acoustic, and auditory-perceptual measures.
summary_zh: 研究嗓音障碍和嗓音功能通过生理学、声学和听觉-知觉测量方法。

name: Sara Kover
dept: Department of Speech and Hearing Sciences
title: Professor and Chair
summary: Studies language development in children with neurodevelopmental disorders such as fragile X syndrome and autism through cognitive and environmental interactions.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍儿童（如脆性X综合症和自闭症）的语言发展，通过认知和环境交互机制。

name: Patricia K. Kuhl
dept: Department of Speech and Hearing Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies early language and brain development through experiments and brain imaging.
summary_zh: 研究早期语言和大脑发展，通过实验和脑成像进行。

name: Ludo Max
dept: Department of Speech and Hearing Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies speech motor control and fluency disorders through sensorimotor integration.
summary_zh: 研究发音运动控制和流畅性障碍方面的传感器整合。

name: Amy Pace
dept: Department of Speech and Hearing Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies language acquisition and development from birth to five, with a focus on dual language learners and early intervention.
summary_zh: 研究从出生到五岁语言习得与发展，重点关注双语学习者和早期干预。

name: Yi Shen
dept: Department of Speech and Hearing Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies individual differences in speech perception mechanisms through auditory models and clinical assessments.
summary_zh: 研究听力损失个体差异的听觉机制，通过听觉模型和临床评估进行。

name: Kristie Spencer
dept: Department of Speech and Hearing Sciences
title: Professor and Associate Chair
summary: Studies speech and hearing through research and education.
summary_zh: 研究和教育言语和听力学。

name: Andrea Berez-Kroeker
title: Associate Dean of Academic Personnel and Operations, College of Arts, Languages & Letters, Professor of Linguistics
areas: digital language archiving and metadata standards
summary: Studies Athabascan languages, language documentation, and intonation through digital archiving and reproducible research.
summary_zh: 研究阿巴斯康语系语言、语言记录以及语调，通过数字存档和可重复研究的方法。

name: Andrew Cheng
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies articulatory and acoustic phonetics, language variation and change, and sociolinguistics through the lens of Korean and English dialectology.
summary_zh: 研究发音生理学和声学、语言变异与变化以及社会语言学，特别是韩语和北美英语方言。

name: Kamil Deen
title: Professor
summary: Studies language acquisition through experimental methods, focusing on morphosyntax, understudied languages like Bantu and Southeast Asian languages, and bilingualism.
summary_zh: 通过实验方法研究语言获得，重点关注形态句法、未研究过的语言如班图语和东南亚语言以及双语现象。

name: Shelece Easterday
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies phonology, typology, language change, and linguistic complexity in endangered and under-resourced languages.
summary_zh: 研究濒危和资源不足语言的音系学、类型学、语言变化和语言复杂性。

name: Shin Fukuda
title: Professor and Graduate Chair
summary: Studies syntax, lexical semantics, and their interface phenomena through theoretical and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究句法学、词汇语义学及其界面现象，采用理论和实验方法。

name: Gary Holton
title: Professor
summary: Studies Austronesian, Na-Dene, and Papuan languages through documentation and historical analysis.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语系、纳德内语系和波利尼西亚语言的语言记录和历史语言学。

name: Bradley McDonnell
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies Austronesian languages through language documentation and corpus linguistics.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语系语言的语言记录和语料库语言学。

name: William O'Grady
title: Professor
summary: Studies syntactic theory and experimental syntax through language acquisition and heritage language revitalization.
summary_zh: 研究句法学理论和实验句法，通过语言习得和濒危语言复兴。

name: Leah Pappas
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies Austronesian languages, focusing on community-oriented language documentation, space, typology, and gesture.
summary_zh: 研究南岛语族语言，侧重于社区语言记录、空间、类型学和手势。

name: Amy Schafer
title: Professor and Department Chair
summary: Studies sentence comprehension and production in Korean, Japanese, and Austronesian languages using experimental methods.
summary_zh: 使用实验方法研究韩语、日语和澳大利亚语系语言的句子理解和生成。

name: Joshua Bousquette
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和句法学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

name: Pilar Chamorro Fernández
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Spanish dialects through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究西班牙方言的音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行。

name: Jonathan Evans
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和句法学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

name: Jon Forrest
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和句法学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

name: Victoria Hasko
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和句法学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

name: Chad Howe
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和句法学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

name: Ryan Ka Yau Lai
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies linguistic phenomena through advising and mentoring students.
summary_zh: 指导学生，研究语言学现象。

name: Keith Langston
title: University Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和句法学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

name: Vera Lee-Schoenfeld
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in multiple languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究多个语言的音系学和句法学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

name: Alexandra Pfiffner
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和句法学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

name: Sonia Shiri
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和句法学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

name: Ling Sun
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in East Asian languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究东亚语言的音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行。

name: Irina Burukina
title: Faculty
summary: Studies syntax, argument structure, and clausal subordination in Mayan and Uralic languages through documentation.
summary_zh: 研究玛雅语和乌拉尔语系的语言句法学、论元结构和从句子结构，并进行语言记录。

name: Julian Grove
title: Faculty
summary: Studies formal, computational, and experimental semantics.
summary_zh: 研究形式语义学、计算语义学和实验语义学。

name: Brent Henderson
title: Faculty
summary: Studies syntactic theory, case and agreement, and language documentation with a focus on Bantu languages.
summary_zh: 研究句法学，论元和一致理论，以及班图语系语言的记录工作。

name: Edith Kaan
title: Professor
summary: Studies language comprehension at the sentence level in second-language learners and heritage speakers using psycholinguistic and neurolinguistic methods.
summary_zh: 研究二语学习者和传承者在句子层面的语言理解，使用心理语言学和神经语言学方法。

name: Zoey Liu
title: Faculty
summary: Studies computational linguistics and multilingual natural language processing with a focus on variation and generalization.
summary_zh: 研究计算语言学和多语言自然语言处理，重点关注变异和泛化。

name: Fiona McLaughlin
title: Professor of Linguistics & African Languages
summary: Studies sociolinguistics of urban Africa, multilingualism, and phonology of Atlantic languages through writing and literacy research.
summary_zh: 研究非洲城市社会语言学、多语言接触以及大西洋语言的音系学，通过书写和识字研究。

name: Sarah Moeller
title: Faculty
summary: Studies morphosyntax and natural language processing in indigenous languages of the former Soviet Union through language documentation.
summary_zh: 研究前苏联地区土著语言的形态句法和自然语言处理，通过语言记录学方法。

name: Eleonora Rossi
title: Faculty
summary: Studies psycholinguistics, bilingualism, and the cognitive and neural effects of second language acquisition across the life span.
summary_zh: 研究心理语言学、双语主义以及第二语言习得的认知和神经效应在生命周期中的变化。

name: Alayo Tripp
title: Faculty
summary: Studies social cognition, phonology, and sociophonetics through developmental psycholinguistics.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知、音系学和社会音系学，通过发展语言学进行.

name: Ratree Wayland
title: Professor
summary: Studies cross-language speech perception and production, lexical tone processing, and neurological disorders through Southeast Asian languages.
summary_zh: 研究跨语言语音感知与生产、词调处理以及神经疾病的社会语言学和语言习得。

name: Caroline Wiltshire
title: Faculty
summary: Studies phonological theory, second language acquisition, and phonetics, focusing on Dravidian, Tibeto-Burman, and Indian English phonology and phonetics.
summary_zh: 研究音系学理论、第二语言习得和语音学，重点关注德拉威语系、藏缅语系以及印度英语的语音和语音学。

name: Stefanie Wulff
title: Professor
summary: Studies corpus linguistics and construction grammar with a focus on data-driven teaching and second language acquisition.
summary_zh: 研究语料库语言学和构式语法，侧重于数据驱动的教学和二语习得。

name: Amit Almor
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies language processing, anaphoric expressions, sentence production, and memory in aging and Alzheimer's patients using neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理、指代表达、句子生产和记忆在老年和阿尔茨海默病患者中的神经成像.

name: Anne Bezuidenhout
title: Faculty
summary: Studies presuppositions and conversational implicatures using formal and experimental methods, focusing on the processing of non-restrictive relative clauses.
summary_zh: 研究预设和会话含意，使用形式和实验方法，关注非限制性定语从句的处理。

name: Elaine Chun
title: Associate Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies language and racism in U.S. public space and language in transnational social media contexts.
summary_zh: 研究美国公共空间中的语言和种族主义以及跨国社交媒体中的语言。

name: Stanley Dubinsky
title: Professor
summary: Studies syntax and semantics, focusing on syntactic theory and the syntax-semantics interface across various languages.
summary_zh: 研究句法学和语义学，专注于句法理论及其与语义学的接口，涉及多种语言。

name: Lewis Esposito
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies language variation and change, particularly in relation to gender and sexuality, through sociophonetics and style.
summary_zh: 研究语言变异与变化，特别是在性别和性取向上，通过社会音系学和风格研究。

name: Kurt Goblirsch
title: Professor
summary: Studies sound change, word forms, and word origins in Germanic languages through comparative analysis.
summary_zh: 研究日耳曼语系语言中的音变、词形和词源通过比较分析。

name: D. Eric Holt
title: Professor
summary: Studies Spanish phonology and language acquisition, particularly connected speech phenomena in English-speaking learners of Spanish.
summary_zh: 研究西班牙语音系学和语言习得，尤其是英语母语者学习西班牙语时的连读现象。

name: Alan Ke
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies syntax, language acquisition, and sentence processing through experimental and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究句法学、语言获得和句子处理，采用实验和计算方法。

name: Jiang Liu
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies phonetics-phonology and second language acquisition, focusing on speech perception and production in bilinguals.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和二语习得，重点关注双语者的语音感知和产生。

name: Paul Malovrh
title: Professor
summary: Studies advanced interlanguage development and psycholinguistic processing strategies in second-language learning through cognitive frameworks and instructional interventions.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言学习中的高级中介语发展和心理语言学处理策略，通过认知框架和教学干预进行探究。

name: Emily Manetta
title: Professor and Director of Linguistics Program
areas: Wh-questions and displacement to the clausal peripheries
summary: Studies the syntax of Indic languages, focusing on wh-questions, verb-second word orders, and ellipsis phenomena.
summary_zh: 研究印地语系语言的句法学，重点关注疑问句、动词第二位和省略现象。

name: Nina Moreno
title: Professor
summary: Studies the impact of feedback types on second language acquisition through computer-assisted language learning and investigates attentional frameworks in language learning.
summary_zh: 研究不同类型反馈对第二语言习得的影响以及语言学习中的注意框架。

name: Jennifer F. Reynolds
title: Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between discourse practices and social and linguistic transformation among rural communities in Guatemala, Mexico, and the U.S. through ethnographic methods.
summary_zh: 研究农村社区（包括危地马拉、墨西哥和美国）日常话语实践与社会和语言转变之间的关系，采用民族志方法。

name: Brandon Waldon
title: Assistant Professor
areas: My research examines the ways in which context
I approach these topics using a variety of tools
summary: Studies the interaction of context, linguistic meaning, and social cognition in communication, using formal analysis, psycholinguistic experiments, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究语境、语言意义和社会认知在交流中的互动，使用形式分析、心理语言学实验和计算建模方法。

name: Tracey L. Weldon
title: Professor
summary: Studies language variation, particularly African American English and Gullah, using sociolinguistic methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言变异，尤其是非裔美国人英语和古拉语，使用社会语言学方法。

name: Olesya Kisselev
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies phonology and syntax in multiple languages through comparative analysis.
summary_zh: 研究多个语言的音系学和句法学。

name: Diane Belcher
dept: Department of Applied Linguistics and Second Language Studies
title: Professor
summary: Studies advanced academic literacy, language for specific purposes, and qualitative research methods in second language writing.
summary_zh: 研究高级学术 literacy、特定目的语言和质性研究方法在第二语言写作中的应用。

name: Dylan Burton
dept: Department of Applied Linguistics and Second Language Studies
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies second language speech assessment, nonverbal behavior, and fairness in language tests through eye-tracking methods.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言口语评估、非言语行为和语言测试的公平性，采用眼动追踪方法。

name: Viviana Cortes
dept: Department of Applied Linguistics and Second Language Studies
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies recurrent word combinations and corpus-based grammatical analyses in academic writing and English grammar.
summary_zh: 研究学术写作和英语语法中的重复词组和基于语料库的语法分析。

name: Sara Cushing
dept: Department of Applied Linguistics and Second Language Studies
title: Professor, Chair
summary: Studies assessment and automated scoring for second language writing through research and workshops.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言写作评估和自动化评分的方法和技术。

name: Daniel Dixon
dept: Department of Applied Linguistics and Second Language Studies
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies language and technology, focusing on computer-assisted language learning and digital games for second language learning.
summary_zh: 研究语言和技术，专注于计算机辅助语言学习和数字游戏在第二语言学习中的应用。

name: YouJin Kim
dept: Department of Applied Linguistics and Second Language Studies
title: Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies second language acquisition and task-based language teaching, focusing on interactional feedback and language-related episodes in oral interaction.
summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得和基于任务的语言教学，重点关注口头互动中的互动反馈和语言相关事件。

name: Stephanie Lindemann
dept: Department of Applied Linguistics and Second Language Studies
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies native speaker attitudes and communication strategies in non-native speaker interactions through speech perception and listener training.
summary_zh: 研究母语使用者在与非母语使用者交流中的态度和策略，通过语音感知和倾听者训练进行考察。

name: Gaisha Oralova
dept: Department of Applied Linguistics and Second Language Studies
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive mechanisms of reading in native and non-native speakers using behavioral, neurophysiological, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究母语和非母语阅读的认知机制，使用行为学、神经生理学和计算方法。

name: Ute Römer
dept: Department of Applied Linguistics and Second Language Studies
title: Professor
summary: Studies corpus linguistics, phraseology, and second language acquisition through corpus-driven approaches and academic discourse analysis.
summary_zh: 研究语料库语言学、短语学和二语习得，通过语料库驱动的方法和学术文体分析。

name: Sara Rosen
dept: Department of Applied Linguistics and Second Language Studies
title: Professor
summary: Studies theoretical and generative syntax, focusing on clausal functional architecture and its contribution to argument and event interpretation across various language families.
summary_zh: 研究理论和生成句法学，关注句法功能结构及其对多种语言家族中论元和事件解释的贡献。
